jobs.title: Project Coordinator

We encourage continual learning, investigation, and reflection within our team to inspire new perspectives and create revolutionary solutions. Stories Illuminated’s goal is for our team to become the best version of themselves while telling special stories throughout the world.

They assist in organizing all aspects of events from conception to execution and support the team to ensure client objectives are achieved.

**Description**  

UCLA Health runs and operates over 300 outpatient clinics located in Southern California with over 3,000,000 outpatient encounters annually. The Patient Access Organization (PAO) serves as the centralized access team for UCLA Health’s ambulatory enterprise, ensuring timely, convenient, and equitable access to care for patients and the communities we serve. Our teams oversee high\-volume centralized scheduling and call center operations, new patient referral intake and navigation, enterprise template and capacity management, workforce training and quality oversight, and scheduling pathways and technology optimization, including decision tree development and digital innovations. We operate at the intersection of operations, technology, and clinical partnership to align supply and demand, streamline workflows, and continuously improve how patients enter and engage with UCLA Health.



The Executive Assistant/Special Projects Coordinator for the PAO provides professional analytical support, project coordination and management, as well as specialized and general administrative support. The incumbent is responsible for managing the Senior Director's calendar, correspondence, administrative tasks and various projects as assigned. This role will also support other leadership team members across the PAO.

jobs.title: Experiential Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**Hadrian \- Manufacturing the Future**
=======================================


Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full\-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission\-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

  

Following our $1\.37B Series D at a $7\.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory\-as\-a\-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

  

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

  

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

**The Role**
------------


Hadrian is hiring an Experiential Marketing Manager to own every moment where someone meets Hadrian in person. This is the single owner of our events portfolio, from a twelve\-person dinner in a private room to a flagship launch built around a working factory floor.


This role exists because physical experience is our highest\-conviction channel. The people we most want to reach, the engineers building autonomous systems and the machinists and technicians who run them, do not decide where to spend the next five years of their career because of an ad. They decide after they walk a floor, put their hands on a part, and talk to the people doing the work. Your job is to engineer that encounter and then run it at scale across multiple cities.


You will inherit a portfolio that is already in motion and under\-resourced, and you will own it end to end: strategy, calendar, budget, vendors, production, staffing, and the follow\-through that turns a good night into a hire or a customer conversation. This is a builder role with real budget and real autonomy, not a coordinator role executing someone else’s brief.

**Why Now**
-----------


We are scaling our manufacturing footprint across multiple sites and hiring aggressively into the Bay Area and beyond, and our events calendar is about to go from occasional to continuous. Several things are already live: recruiting\-driven dinners and socials, a multi\-month brand and talent campaign anchored in the Bay Area, and a set of factory and site moments tied to new capability launches. The next twelve months include a flagship culminating event whose format is still being decided. You will have a direct hand in that decision rather than inheriting it.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

**Own the portfolio**

* Own the full events and experiential calendar end to end, across owned events, recruiting events, executive hosting, site and factory moments, and our presence at third\-party industry conferences.
* Build the portfolio strategy: decide what we show up to, what we build ourselves, what we sponsor, and what we decline, and be able to defend each call on audience and cost.
* Own the events budget, including vendor selection, negotiation, production spend, and reconciliation. Bring a point of view on where a dollar buys more experience.

**Build the flagship moments**

* Lead production on flagship brand and launch events, including the format decision, venue and site selection, run of show, talent and speaker logistics, and executive prep.
* Design factory and site experiences that let people see the machines and the work. Partner closely with site leadership and operations so that hosting visitors never compromises production, safety, or export\-control obligations.
* Sequence events against the broader campaign calendar, including out of home, content, and media moments, so that a launch reads as one connected push rather than several unrelated dates.

**Run the recruiting engine in person**

* Build a repeatable cadence of recruiting\-driven experiences: curated dinners and salons, technical talks and demo nights, happy hours near our sites, and targeted socials for specific engineering and skilled\-trade audiences.
* Partner with talent brand and recruiting on invite strategy, guest curation, and the handoff that turns an attendee into a pipeline candidate. Attendance is not the metric. Conversations and hires are.
* Develop formats that travel, so a dinner series or demo night can run in a new city without rebuilding it from scratch each time.

**Operate and measure**

* Stand up the operating infrastructure this function currently lacks: a single source\-of\-truth events calendar, briefing and run\-of\-show templates, vendor roster, budget tracker, and post\-event debriefs.
* Define what success means per event type before the event happens, then report honestly against it, including when something did not work.
* Manage agencies, production partners, and contract staff. Hold them to a standard and replace them when they miss it.

**Partner across the company**

* Work directly with the executive team, including the CEO, on hosting, speaking moments, and the guest experience for high\-stakes visits.
* Coordinate with communications on anything press\-facing, and respect the review paths that govern customer, program, and export\-controlled information.
* Partner with government relations and policy on conference presence and official visits as those functions come online.

jobs.title: TEAMS Sales Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
At FIGS, we celebrate, empower, and serve those who serve others. Through TEAMS, we're bringing that same mission to entire healthcare institutions by outfitting hospitals, clinics, schools, and healthcare systems with the scrubs they deserve. To support our growth, we are seeking a **Sales Operations Coordinator.** The ideal candidate issomeone who loves details, enjoys building processes, and wants to help a fast\-moving sales team spend more time selling and less time stuck in admin updates..



This is a high\-impact, behind\-the\-scenes role for someone who's organized, process\-driven, and passionate about clean operations.


### **What You'll Own**


**Help Reps Move Faster:** Support our TEAMS sales reps by handling administrative tasks like quoting, invoicing, contract entry, logo digitizing, and catalog updates so they can focus on building relationships.


**Clean Up the Backend:** Manage and maintain product collections, pricing data, and customer records across HubSpot and internal tools. Spot issues before they become problems.


**Support Sales Ops Reporting \& Light Data Work:** Help track deals, fix CRM inconsistencies, and use tools like SQL or Looker to clean up messy data.


**Cross\-Functional Coordination:** Work closely with Sales, Finance, CX, and Marketing to ensure alignment, accuracy, and speed across teams. Be the glue.


**Build Repeatable Processes:** As we scale, help document best practices and optimize workflows so the system grows with us.


### **Who You Are**


* **Organized**: You thrive in a clean spreadsheet and never let things fall through the cracks.
* **Operationally strong:** You like knowing how everything works and where it can work better.
* **Process\-minded:** You're always looking for ways to improve how work gets done.
* **Clear communicator:** You write it down, follow up, and help everyone stay aligned.
* **Technically curious:** You're comfortable in CRMs and interested in tools like SQL or Airtable.

### **What You Bring**


* 2\+ years in sales ops, deal desk, or a coordination\-heavy admin role (bonus for B2B or SaaS)
* HubSpot, Salesforce, Shopify or similar CRM experience
* Intermediate Excel/Google Sheets skills (pivot tables, vlookups, data cleanup)
* Bonus: experience or interest in SQL, Airtable, or database tools
* High attention to detail and pride in getting it right

### **Why This Role Rocks**


* You'll make a real impact on day one
* You'll get exposure to multiple functions across the company
* You'll help build something new and scalable
* You'll be part of a mission\-driven brand that's changing healthcare


Let's show the world what TEAMS can do.


**FIGS Compensation and Benefits**


*Pay Range*


* At FIGS, your base salary is one part of your total compensation package. This role's base salary range is between $29 and $31/hr. Actual hourly rate is determined based on a number of factors, including but not limited to your relevant skills, qualifications, and years of experience.


*Additional Compensation and Benefits*


* Other compensation and benefits offered include:
* + Comprehensive benefits and perks package focused on your well\-being, including premium medical, dental and vision coverage, and full access to wellness services through Breethe and Classpass. 100% FIGS\-sponsored life insurance and disability insurance
	+ Amazing 401(k) program, with a company match up to the first 6% of your contribution
	+ Generous paid time off \- We have 12 company holidays. For salaried team members, we offer flexible vacation. For our hourly team members, we offer up to 3 weeks of accrued vacation
	+ Meaningful time away for baby bonding, including parental leave, new parent care meals, and a transition back to work for primary caregivers
	+ FIGS sponsored Uber Eats voucher for in\-office weeks
	+ Personalized discount code for 50% off all FIGS products, along with a separate code to share with family and friends to enjoy a 25% discount site\-wide
	+ Access to FIGS Vet, Discounted Pet Daycare, Discounted Pet Insurance, and so much more…
* *Benefits eligibility is determined by hour requirements and length of service*

  


**A little bit about us…**



FIGS, Inc. is a founder\-led, direct\-to\-consumer healthcare apparel and lifestyle brand that seeks to celebrate, empower and serve current and future generations of healthcare professionals. We redefine what scrubs are by creating technically advanced apparel and products that feature an unmatched combination of comfort, durability, function and style, all at an affordable price. With the largest DTC platform in healthcare apparel, we sell our products to a rapidly growing community of loyal customers. jobs.title: Outside Sales & Account Manager – Property Management & Restaurant Accounts
jobs.description:
**Commercial Account Manager – Outside Sales, Plumbing Services (LA)**

EZ Plumbing – North Hollywood, CA  
Full\-time \| Salary \+ commission  
$48,000 base salary \+ uncapped commission \| $70,000–78,000 first year at quota \| $85,000–110,000 years two and three

EZ Plumbing has served the LA area since 1989\. We're hiring one person to build and own a book of commercial accounts: property management companies, HOAs, apartment buildings, and restaurants. Half the job is landing them. The other half is keeping them, growing them, and being the person they call. You get paid on everything your accounts spend with us for as long as they stay yours.

This is a field role. You'll be in property management offices, on job sites, and in restaurant back doors, not behind a desk.

The two halves of the job

**Landing accounts**

* Cold walk\-ins, calls, and follow\-ups to property managers, HOA boards, building owners, and restaurant operators across the LA metro
* Get EZ Plumbing onto vendor lists, get rate sheets accepted, and get maintenance agreements signed
* Deliver our vendor packet (license, insurance, W\-9, references) and walk them through it
* 15\+ in\-person visits and 40\+ total touches per week during your first year

**Managing accounts**

* Quarterly check\-in with every account in your book, in person or by phone, and a visit anytime an account goes quiet
* Own renewals: annual rate sheet updates and maintenance agreement renewals
* Grow the account: turn a one\-time repair customer into a scheduled program (drain jetting, sump and storm drain maintenance, backflow testing, water heater service, grease and floor drain service for restaurants)
* Be the first call when a property manager has a problem with a job. You don't fix it, you own it: get dispatch and the tech involved, follow it through, and call the customer back
* Stay on top of your accounts' invoices. You know the property manager, so you call before accounting does
* Track account health in ServiceTitan: last job date, revenue trend, open receivables. Nothing in your book goes 90 days without a touch
* Weekly report to the owner: new accounts, visits, accounts touched, at\-risk accounts, receivables over 60 days

Your first year is roughly 70% hunting and 30% managing. As your book grows, that flips. By year three most of your time is managing 60 to 80 accounts that pay you every month.

**Who we're looking for**

* 2\+ years outside sales, door\-to\-door, or field\-based B2B experience where you kept the accounts you signed. Route sales, uniforms, pest control, commercial cleaning, foodservice distribution, security, HVAC, or anyone who's sold to property managers: we want to talk to you
* You can walk into an office cold, get past the front desk, and leave with a name and a next step
* You follow up. Relentlessly. You have a system and you can describe it
* You've kept accounts for years, not just signed them, and you can tell us how
* You're comfortable being the person a customer calls when they're unhappy
* Organized enough to run a 50\-account book without letting any of them go cold
* Valid California driver's license and clean driving record
* Comfortable with 90% of your week in the field
* No plumbing experience required. We'll teach you what you need to sell it and manage it

**How you get paid**

* $48,000 base salary ($4,000/month), guaranteed
* $150 for every new account you sign, paid when their first invoice is paid
* 3% of everything your accounts pay us, labor and materials, for two years from the day they start, then 1% for as long as you keep the account active
* $2,000 quarterly bonus for hitting your account quota, keeping 90% of your book active, and keeping their bills current
* Year one at quota: $70,000–78,000\. Year two with a built book: $85,000–95,000\. Year three: $95,000–110,000, most of it recurring

The account management side is where the money is. The 1% that continues after year two, the retention bonus, and the growth from turning repair customers into maintenance programs are all paid for keeping accounts, not signing them.

Two things to know up front: commissions pay when the customer pays, not when the job is booked. And an account stays yours only if you're actively working it. Sign it and forget it and it goes back to the house.

**What we provide**

* Company vehicle or $500/month vehicle allowance, plus gas card
* Company phone and laptop
* All sales materials: rate sheets, one\-pagers, vendor packets, business cards
* Paid sick leave per California and City of LA law, 5 days vacation year one, 10 days year two

Not offered: health insurance, 401(k)

Schedule  
Monday to Friday, you set your own days within business hours. Exempt outside sales position, no overtime.

To apply  
Submit your resume and answer the screening questions. We read every answer. Candidates who pass move to a 15\-minute phone screen, then a ride\-along day with the owner.

EZ Plumbing is a family\-owned, C\-36 licensed plumbing contractor (CSLB \#583868\), 11478 Burbank Blvd, North Hollywood, CA 91601\.

Pay: $48,000\.00 \- $110,000\.00 per year

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Application Question(s):

* Describe the last job where most of your week was spent in the field making cold contacts. What did you sell and to whom?
* Walk me through your follow\-up system. What happens after a first visit where you got a name but no commitment?
* Tell me about an account you personally kept for two or more years. What did you do to keep it, and what did you do when they were unhappy?
* How did you track your accounts in your last role? What told you an account was about to leave?
* How many in\-person cold visits did you average per week in your last sales role?
* Do you have a valid California driver's license and a driving record insurable by a commercial policy?

Experience:

* Outside Sales, Field Sales, or Account Management.: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in

**Client Experience Administrative Support**

**Location:** In\-office – Burbank, CA**Position Summary**  
The Client Experience Administrative Support role supports the Client Experience team by managing recurring operational, reporting, monitoring, and follow\-up responsibilities. This position helps keep client\-related workflows organized and moving while allowing Client Experience Representatives to focus on direct client communication, escalations, and account management.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor ETAs, frozen orders, pending orders, and past\-due searches and coordinate routine follow\-up.
* Complete daily system maintenance and identify items requiring CSR or Research attention.
* Maintain recurring client spreadsheets, reports, tracking documents, and client/account information.
* Gather and organize county and jurisdiction delay information for CSR review and client communication.
* Assist with routine Research follow\-ups, track responses, and route more complex issues to the appropriate CSR.
* Maintain accurate documentation and records in HubSpot and other internal systems.
* Identify aging orders, missing information, or potential service concerns and escalate them proactively.
* Support the Client Experience team with additional administrative and operational tasks as needed.

**Mandatory Skills / Technical Requirements**  
Strong organization and attention to detail; ability to manage multiple priorities and recurring deadlines; professional written communication; proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and general computer systems; ability to learn internal platforms and workflows quickly; dependable follow\-through.

**Preferred Skills**  
Experience in administrative support, customer service, client services, background screening (preferred), or another detail\-oriented operational environment. Experience with reporting/tracking spreadsheets, order\-management systems, or working across multiple internal departments is a plus.

**Success in the Role**  
Someone who is organized, proactive, dependable, and comfortable taking ownership of recurring responsibilities. They should identify issues before they become escalations, communicate clearly with the team, and consistently look for ways to make processes more efficient while supporting InfoCheck Solutions’ collaborative and client\-focused culture.

Pay: $21\.00 \- $23\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Sales Representative - S. Central California
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**


Great Minds is a high\-growth, mission\-driven organization founded by educators in 2007\. As a for\-profit, Public Benefit Corporation, we believe all students deserve access to meaningful, challenging content—and all teachers deserve tools that are intuitive, effective, and built for the realities of today’s classrooms.


We develop high\-quality, knowledge\-rich math, science and ELA curricula grounded in research and designed in collaboration with educators. Our materials reflect real classroom needs and are built to drive lasting student outcomes.


We are committed to usability, coherence, and practical implementation—supporting teachers not just through curriculum, but with professional learning, purposeful technology, and responsive service that enable strong adoption and impact.

 **What We Build**


Our products—**Eureka Math** and **Eureka Math²**, **Wit \& Wisdom**, **Geodes**, and the newly launched **Arts \& Letters ELA**—are trusted by thousands of schools and districts nationwide.

* **Eureka Math** is the most widely used math curriculum in the U.S., and is focused on balancing conceptual understanding, procedural fluency, and application.
* **Wit \& Wisdom®** and **Arts \& Letters ELA™** anchor our reading strategy with content\-rich, grade\-level instruction that integrates literature, history, and the arts, grounded in the science of reading. **Geodes®** complements our reading suite with decodable texts that pair phonics with meaningful content to support early literacy.


These programs reflect a shared belief in high expectations, joyful rigor, and deep respect for educators and students.

 **Where We’re Headed**


Great Minds is entering a new stage of growth and product maturity. We are focused on building more connected, customer\-informed experiences across the full educator journey—from curriculum to professional learning to platform and support.

  

Our long\-term vision is to become a true partner in impact—not just delivering curriculum, but supporting educators in achieving outcomes at scale.

**Overview:**


The Sales Representative at Great Minds is committed to expanding district partnerships and promoting the adoption of high\-quality instructional materials and services. In this role, you will drive the full sales cycle for enterprise accounts by building strong, trust\-based relationships with district stakeholders. You will represent Great Minds with professionalism and expertise, helping districts achieve lasting student outcomes through our knowledge\-rich curricula.

**Key Responsibilities:**

*Sales Strategy and Execution:*

* Drive the full sales cycle for enterprise accounts by building strong, trust\-based relationships with district stakeholders.
* Develop and execute a comprehensive territory plan for new sales, renewals, and services to expand the market footprint and achieve sales targets.
* Leverage data to build, monitor, and continually refine territory forecasts in collaboration with sales leadership.
* Manage the territory budget effectively to ensure alignment with organizational goals.
* Continuously assess the competitive landscape by gathering market intelligence and have a deep understanding of unique district priorities, the state and local political context impacting education decisions, and the latest research and evidence\-based practices.

*Pipeline and Lead Management:*

* Proactively build and manage a robust sales pipeline by continuously assessing district needs, staying informed about upcoming district adoptions, and maintaining accurate and up\-to\-date territory data to support strategic planning and execution.
* Manage inbound and outbound leads, driving timely follow\-up and guiding prospects through discovery meetings to uncover new sales opportunities.
* Confidently engage with district\-level decision\-makers through clear, professional communication.
* Deliver compelling sales presentations and support pilots for Tier 2 accounts.

*Relationship Building and Stakeholder Engagement:*

* Build strong, influential relationships with key stakeholders by conducting regular in\-person district visits, participating in regional events, and supporting implementations.
* Lead territory strategy in collaboration with Pre\-Sales and Success Teams, fostering cross\-functional coordination to support high\-impact opportunities.
* Provide actionable insights to the Regional Sales Director to inform senior leadership communication.
* Maintain regular check\-ins with districts to support successful implementations and facilitate connections to implementation resources, including the Success Team.

 **Required Qualifications:**

* 5\+ years of sales experience, preferably in the educational sector, with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
* Strong knowledge of educational programs, curriculum, and pedagogy, with the ability to articulate the value of educational solutions clearly and compellingly.
* Proven success in managing and growing a sales pipeline within a designated territory, using CRM tools such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
* Experience working in cross\-functional teams, particularly collaborating with Pre\-Sales, Success, and Implementation teams to support customer success.
* Bachelor’s degree (Education, Business, Marketing, or Liberal Arts).

**Location:**

* This is a remote position; however, candidates must reside within the designated territory to be considered.
* For this role, we are seeking candidates based in Kern County, Ventura County, or California.

**Compensation:**


The base salary range for this position is $81,000\-$86,000, however the offered salarymay be higher or lower than the above range dependent on numerous factors including, but not limited to location, work experience, skills and internal equity considerations. The base salary is not inclusive of benefits or other incentives.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Periodically lifting, reaching, and moving

jobs.title: Social Media Manager and Graphic Designer
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Seven Arrows is a small\-by\-design, K–6 independent elementary school in Santa Monica, California. Our mission is to inspire students to be passionate learners and compassionate leaders who value life long learning and embody integrity. We are an academically rigorous school that believes the visual and performing arts, sportsmanship, and global citizenship are just as important as core homeroom subjects.

That spirit comes to life throughout the year in our cross\-curricular festivals and every Friday morning at Kuyam, our all\-community gathering featuring student performances, our parent band, interviews with our graduating sixth graders, and special guest speakers and performers. Everything we share with the world should reflect that full picture.

We're looking for a creative, versatile storyteller who can capture the many sides of life at Seven Arrows and help us tell our story with clarity, consistency, and heart.

**The Role**

The Social Media Manager \& Graphic Designer brings the school's visual and social presence to life. This person will translate our mission, vision, and the aesthetic into compelling content across social platforms, print, and digital materials. You'll work closely with the Head of School and senior leadership team to make sure every post and every design moves our message forward.

This role is ideal for someone who can quickly absorb an organization's identity, from its values and voice to its visual style, and then produce polished work at a steady, fast pace without losing quality.

**What You'll Do**

**Social Media**

* Plan, create, and publish content across platforms, maintaining a consistent content calendar aligned with the school year and key events.
* Capture the day\-to\-day life of the school through photography, short\-form video, and stories that reflect our mission and community.
* Capture and share signature school moments, including our weekly Kuyam gatherings and cross\-curricular festivals, through photography, video, and timely posts.
* Write captions and copy in the school's voice, ensuring every post supports our messaging priorities.
* Monitor engagement and analytics, share regular insights, and adjust strategy based on what resonates with families, prospective families, and alumni.
* Respond to comments and messages in a timely, professional manner and flag sensitive issues to leadership.

**Graphic Design**

* Design print and digital materials including, but not limited to: event invitations, newsletters, signage, presentations, social graphics, and programs for festivals.
* Create internal materials for the senior leadership team, such as organizational charts, presentations, facilities planning visuals, and other documents used for school operations and planning.
* Uphold the school's brand standards, ensuring all materials match the established aesthetic.
* Maintain an organized library of templates, brand assets, and photography.
* Manage multiple projects and competing deadlines, often with quick turnarounds during peak seasons.

**What We're Looking For**

**Brand and Mission Alignment**

* A strong instinct for understanding an organization's ethos, voice, and visual identity, and the ability to reflect it quickly and accurately in your work.
* Comfort taking direction and feedback from leadership, and turning it into refined work without losing momentum.
* Genuine interest in education, the magic of childhood, and in telling the story of a school community.

**Experience and Skills**

* 3–5 years of experience in social media management, graphic design, or a combined creative role; school, nonprofit, or mission\-driven experience is a plus.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and Canva; video editing experience (Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar) strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of social scheduling and analytics tools.
* Solid photography and short\-form video skills.
* Excellent writing and editing skills with a sharp eye for detail.
* A portfolio that shows both social content and design work across print and digital.

**Work Style**

* Thrives in a fast\-paced environment and consistently delivers high\-quality work on tight timelines.
* Excellent collaborator and thrives when working in a team
* Highly organized, self\-directed, and able to juggle many projects at once.
* Adaptable and responsive to feedback.
* Available for occasional evening or weekend school events.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your resume, a brief cover letter, and a link to your portfolio. In your cover letter, tell us about a time you had to quickly learn and capture an organization's brand or voice. Finalists may be asked to complete a short design and social media exercise.

Pay: $72,000\.00 \- $78,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Sales Representative
jobs.description:
##### **For over 35 years, Peak Technologies has been at the forefront of providing end\-to\-end enterprise mobility, managed services, printing and mobile data capture solutions for performance\-driven organizations focused on the optimization of supply chain and field\-based business processes.**

##### **JOB SUMMARY \& SCOPE:**

##### **Drive the sales of service programs/products to meet/exceed customer needs as well as drive revenue.**

##### **KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

* Drive the sale of service programs, to meet/exceed sales and margin goals.
* Use existing customer base and new lead information to develop and increase the sales of service offerings.
* Work as an individual team member, to meet/exceed individual and/or team service sales targets and goals.
* Track and manage sales opportunities from lead to finalization of service contracts.
* Facilitate proper quoting, positioning, promoting and selling of services to ensure high close rates.
* Ensure accurate forecasting, account planning, and reports are maintained and submitted on a weekly, monthly and quarterly basis.
* Build and maintain long\-term customer retention and relationships by researching and developing existing customers, as well as new leads.
* Responsible for assigned accounts but may be required to transition accounts to other sales teams/business segments as determined.
* Ensure a strategic, “One Peak” mindset – managing accounts and business priorities.
* Work closely with various Sales Leadership.
* Establish and maintain good business relations with customers and external contacts, including our partner community.
* Maintain effective working relationships, communication, and coordination with all co\-workers, and leadership.

##### **EDUCATION \+ EXPERIENCE \+ KEY TRAITS:**

* Bachelor's degree (B. A.) from four\-year college or university; up to 5 years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* Competencies: Sales Management, organizational development skills and competencies.

##### **TYPICAL PERFORMANCE TARGETS:**

* SERVICE DELIVERY: Sustained, measured excellence in project \& process delivery.
* COST TO SERVE: Sustained, measured excellence in delivery efficiency with expected continuous improvement.
* INNOVATION: Step changed delivery in safety, quality, and/or cost.

##### **LANGUAGE SKILLS:**

* Primary language used in daily operations is English.
* Read and interpret documents, procedure manuals and various correspondence from both internal and external
* Speak effectively, both individually and before groups of both external customers and/or various levels of employees within the organization

##### **SUPERVISION:**

* Role is not responsible for supervising direct or indirect reports.

##### **DECISION MAKING \+ REASONING:**

* Able to take accountability and responsibility for business target delivery and decision\-making.

##### **MATHEMATICAL SKILLS:**

* Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

##### **REASONING ABILITY:**

* Define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
* Interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.
* Ability to follow detailed instructions and utilize existing resources to solve problems

##### **WORKING RELATIONSHIPS:**

* Peak Senior Management Team.
* Key Customer Sr. Leadership.
* Key Vendor Sr. Leadership.

##### **COMPUTER SKILLS:**

* To perform this job successfully, an individual should have knowledge of Excel Spreadsheet software, Word Processing, and PowerPoint presentation software. CRM skills required.

**WHO WE ARE:**  

We are an end\-to\-end Renewable Energy provider. We offer products to commercial and enterprise clients in EV Charging solutions, Fleet Electrification, Solar Micro\-grids, Energy storage, Hydroponic farming and Rain Water/Grey Water collection systems. We have been experiencing tremendous growth in all these areas and operate under several government rebate programs that ensure a steady and reliable flow of revenues. Our company handles the entire flow of providing these products and services beginning with Sales, Provisioning, Design and Engineering, Contracting and Construction, Servicing and Maintenance. If you are passionate about the EV industry and working with awesome teams in a fast\-growing company, we want to speak with you! Join us in making a meaningful impact!  

**Job Summary**  

This role entails making cold calls and sales calls to prospects across 4 states to sell them on our EV charging products while clearly articulating the incentives, rebates, and revenues for these products. Candidates must be able to fully comprehend a rather complicated business model and articulate it effectively to the prospect, and then work with internal tools to provide proposals, contracts, case studies, model scenarios, etc. This is an hourly role with commission.

* Generate and qualify new sales opportunities by conducting high\-volume cold calls, outbound sales calls, direct marketing activities, and market research to identify potential clients within the EV charging and renewable energy industries.

* Develop new business through referrals and networking by sourcing client referrals, participating in sales events, and identifying additional opportunities to expand the company's customer base.
* Support market and competitive research by monitoring competitors, market conditions, product development, and industry trends, as well as conducting market research and surveys.

**Requirements**  

* High school diploma required; BA/BS is a plus.
* 3\-5 years of experience as a Telemarketer.
* Superb communication and customer service skills, including the ability to remain calm under pressure.
* Excellent multitasking skills.
* Comfortable making cold calls to potential clients.
* A goal\-driven, results\-oriented mindset.
* Working knowledge of computer software, including Microsoft Office Suite.

jobs.title: Technical Sales Representative, Pacific Southwest Region
jobs.description:
*Carlisle Companies is a leading manufacturer of building envelope products and solutions that make buildings more energy efficient, durable, and sustainable.*


*We deliver roofing, insulation, waterproofing, and architectural systems for commercial and residential projects using a focus on innovation and continuous improvement to solve today's challenges.*


*We're equally committed to our people, prioritizing safety, inclusion, career growth development, tuition assistance, and excellent benefits.*


*With manufacturing, engineering, R\&D, and corporate functions across North America and globally, Carlisle offers stability, agility, and opportunity in a performance\-driven culture. Do meaningful work and shape the future of building solutions; apply today and come grow with us.*


**Job Summary:**



The Technical Sales Representative is responsible for driving specification influence, technical adoption, territory development, and sales growth through direct engagement with architects, consultants, building owners, contractors, distributors, and sales representatives. This customer\-facing role combines consultative selling, technical expertise, project support, and strategic business development to promote Carlisle SynTec Systems and achieve regional sales objectives. Approximately 80% of the role is focused on direct customer engagement, project influence, and territory development activities, while the remaining 20% is dedicated to technical training, Territory Development Plan (TDP) activities, professional development, new product growth initiatives, and internal collaboration. The position involves regular travel throughout the assigned territory, including overnight stays, with occasional weekend travel required to attend industry events, regional meetings, and other business\-related activities. **Candidates are required to be in the Los Angeles or San Diego areas to be considered.**





**Duties and Responsibilities:**


* Build and maintain strong relationships with architects, consultants, building owners, contractors, distributors, and independent representatives to influence specifications, support project development, and drive product adoption.
* Regularly travel throughout the assigned territory to promote Carlisle, identify project opportunities, and support strategic business growth initiatives.
* Plan, coordinate, and deliver AIA\-approved or AIA\-aligned presentations, lunch\-and learns, hands\-on demonstrations, classroom training, virtual learning sessions, and field\-based educational programs for architects, consultants, contractors, distributors, and other construction professionals.
* Engage engineering and design consultants by providing technical data, testing information, code compliance guidance, and application recommendations to support proper system selection.
* Work directly with building owners and end users to present solutions focused on performance, durability, lifecycle value, sustainability, and return on investment.
* Partner with contractors and distributors to support product selection, project execution, application best practices, pre\-construction planning, and successful installation outcomes.
* Review project specifications, drawings, and construction documents to ensure appropriate product selection and identify opportunities for specification influence.
* Collaborate with Sales Support, Technical Services, Product Management, and Regional Sales leadership to secure project opportunities and support customer needs.
* Assist customers with pricing requests, submittal packages, product substitutions, system recommendations, warranty information, code approvals, and project specific technical documentation.
* Provide project follow\-up support including specifications, drawings, samples, technical literature, application guidance, and troubleshooting assistance.
* Track presentation activity, specification opportunities, project influence efforts, and territory performance using CRM and reporting systems.
* Facilitate Territory Development Plan (TDP) activities, including strategic planning, growth initiatives, monthly sustainment calls, and professional development objectives.
* Support onboarding and ongoing education programs for sales teams, distributors, contractors, and other stakeholders.
* Assist with new product launches and market development initiatives by educating customers on product benefits, applications, competitive advantages, and market opportunities.
* Attend industry events, trade shows, association meetings, and professional development activities to strengthen customer relationships and remain informed of market trends.
* Provide regular territory reports, activity summaries, and market intelligence to management regarding project opportunities, competitive activity, and territory performance.
* Serve as a liaison between building owners, architects, consultants, contractors, distributors, and internal stakeholders to support project success.
* Stay current on building codes, industry standards, construction practices, competitive products, and emerging market trends.
* Perform other duties as assigned.


**Required Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**


* Knowledge of building materials, roofing systems, construction methods, and architectural specifications.
* Understanding of specification\-driven sales processes and project influence strategies.
* Strong relationship\-building, consultative selling, and business development skills.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Experience in creating and delivering professional training and educational programs.
* Ability to interpret construction drawings, specifications, and technical documentation.
* Knowledge of CRM platforms, Microsoft Office Suite, and virtual collaboration tools.
* Working knowledge of CAD platforms and construction\-related software.
* Strong organizational, analytical, and time management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects

Crawford \& Associates, Inc. is a geotechnical engineering, engineering geology, and construction materials testing firm founded in 2012, now with over 85 employees across nine offices in California and Washington State. We're a team of engineers, geologists, and specialists who love solving tough problems, whether that's a bridge foundation, a water line, a new school, or the next big development. Crawford \& Associates, Inc. is hiring a Business Development Coordinator for our Costa Mesa office that we opened this year. This role is a split between business development and recruiting. * Represent Crawford at career fairs and campus events, primarily in Southern California.

***Operational Support (approx. 10%)**** Provide light administrative support to the Costa Mesa office as needed.

**WHO WE ARE:**  

We are an end\-to\-end Renewable Energy provider. We offer products to commercial and enterprise clients in EV Charging solutions, Fleet Electrification, Solar Micro\-grids, Energy storage, Hydroponic farming and Rain Water/Grey Water collection systems. We have been experiencing tremendous growth in all these areas and operate under several government rebate programs that ensure a steady and reliable flow of revenues. Our company handles the entire flow of providing these products and services beginning with Sales, Provisioning, Design and Engineering, Contracting and Construction, Servicing and Maintenance. If you are passionate about the EV industry and working with awesome teams in a fast\-growing company, we want to speak with you! Join us in making a meaningful impact!  

**Job Summary**  

This role entails making cold calls and sales calls to prospects across 4 states to sell them on our EV charging products while clearly articulating the incentives, rebates, and revenues for these products. Candidates must be able to fully comprehend a rather complicated business model and articulate it effectively to the prospect, and then work with internal tools to provide proposals, contracts, case studies, model scenarios, etc. This is an hourly role with commission.  

**Responsibilities**  

* Generate and qualify new sales opportunities by conducting high\-volume cold calls, outbound sales calls, direct marketing activities, and market research to identify potential clients within the EV charging and renewable energy industries.
* Engage with prospective and existing clients by understanding their needs, clearly communicating the benefits of our products and services, and demonstrating how our solutions can address their specific business needs.
* Present and promote company products and services through phone calls, electronic communication, in\-person meetings, sales presentations, promotional materials, and other sales activities.
* Develop sales opportunities from initial contact through close by conducting follow\-ups, developing sales proposals, preparing and presenting contracts, negotiating with clients, and responding to sales inquiries and concerns.
* Maintain accurate customer and sales information by keeping customer databases and sales activity records up to date, documenting calls and sales activity, preparing sales reports, and monitoring follow\-up activities for management.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships by providing responsive customer service, taking incoming customer calls, following up on sales activity, addressing customer concerns, and ensuring overall customer satisfaction.
* Support sales and customer education efforts by developing and maintaining sales and promotional materials, conducting product training, and providing relevant case studies, model scenarios, and other supporting information to prospective clients.
* Develop new business through referrals and networking by sourcing client referrals, participating in sales events, and identifying additional opportunities to expand the company's customer base.
* Support market and competitive research by monitoring competitors, market conditions, product development, and industry trends, as well as conducting market research and surveys.
* Perform quality and sales activity follow\-up by monitoring product and service delivery, conducting quality checks, and reporting sales activities, customer feedback, and follow\-up needs to management.

**Requirements**  

* High school diploma required; BA/BS is a plus.
* 3\-5 years of experience as a Telemarketer.
* Superb communication and customer service skills, including the ability to remain calm under pressure.
* Excellent multitasking skills.
* Comfortable making cold calls to potential clients.
* A goal\-driven, results\-oriented mindset.
* Working knowledge of computer software, including Microsoft Office Suite.
* Knowledge of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT.

**Note:** This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the position. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative - West Coast Based
jobs.description:
**The Company**  

  

Everflow is a SaaS Partner Marketing platform for managing and scaling revenue from affiliates, partnerships, and marketing channels.


Founded in 2016 by industry veterans, we are based in Oakland, Montreal and Amsterdam with a distributed team across the NAM and EMEA regions.  

We’re a bootstrapped company (over $30M ARR) that has grown through supporting happy customers that refer business to us and create word\-of\-mouth excitement. We’re the go\-to platform for brands, agencies, and networks, with 1,000\+ customers including Mutual of Omaha, ClassPass, and Tapjoy.###### **We are accepting applications from candidates that reside in the following areas:**

* California Bay Area \- 2 day in\-office requirement in Downtown Oakland
* LA/OC Area \- 2 Day in\-office requirement in Costa Mesa  

***the in\-office requirement is non\-negotiable***

###### **About the Role**


We are seeking a resourceful and intuitive Business Development Representative who thrives on turning complex challenges into opportunities for connection and growth. You’ll be on the ground floor of a cutting edge company disrupting the multi\-billion dollar ad industry.


As a Business Development Representative, you’ll get exposure to all types of businesses while speaking to stakeholders from ad operations to CEOs. Through a consultative and analytical approach, you’ll be able to help identify real business needs and how Everflow can help them grow.

###### **Full Interview Process:**

* Resume Review
* Recruiter Screen (30 min Zoom)
* Hiring Manager Screen (45 min Zoom)
* In\-Person Interview (up to 1 hour, with a senior member of the Sales Team, location dependent)
* Values Alignment Interview (30 min Zoom)
* References / Offer

###### **Responsibilities:**

* Educate marketing professionals on how Everflow can help them streamline processes and grow their partner marketing program
* Diligently update Hubspot, our CRM, to stay current on leads and follow ups
* Qualify all sales leads and set appointments via chat, email and phone
* Source new sales opportunities through outbound calls and marketing efforts
* Hand off qualified leads to our Account Executives
* Exhibit superior customer service in all prospect/customer engagement
* Shadow our Account Executives to help acquire skills you’ll need for your next role on the Everflow Sales Team

###### **Qualifications:**


While none of these requirements/qualifications are mandatory for hiring, candidates should demonstrate proficiency in some of these areas. As employees advance in their roles, they are anticipated to cultivate deeper expertise across all of these domains.

* Excellent communication and negotiation skills
* Experience with Hubspot is preferred but not required
* Affiliate Networking experience
* Affiliate Marketing Knowledge

###### **Requirements:**

* 1 years of experience as a SDR/BDR/LDR or similar experience
* Bachelor’s Degree required, preferably in Business Administration, Communications, Economics, or other relevant field
* Prior experience and strong level of comfort with Linkedin and email outreach REQUIRED
* High energy, intelligent, driven, eager to learn, and committed to overachievement in all challenges you tackle
* Tech\-savvy, ability to problem solve within the tools you are working in
* Self\-starter with strong work ethic and drive to succeed
* Self\-sufficient
* Ability to thrive in a task and goal\-driven sales environment
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills
* A can\-do attitude

###### **Compensation**


Annual Base Salary: $60,000 \- $70,000  

Uncapped Bonus Potential

###### **Perks include:**

* Employer Covered Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
* Unlimited PTO
* Paid parental leave for putting your family first
* Startup\-like environment, without the constant rush to raise the next round of funding
* A very collaborative team and culture
* Education, gym, and equipment stipend

### **Join Our Exceptional Team**


Dive into a role where respect, ownership, and mindfulness define our culture. As a valued team member, you'll enjoy the freedom to innovate and excel, supported by the tools and equipment you need to succeed.### **Balance, Growth, and Connection**

**Work/Life Harmony:** Embrace unlimited PTO and a healthy balance that respects your life outside work.**Continuous Growth:** Regular feedback and discussions about your career path keep you moving forward.**Inclusive Community:** Be part of a welcoming, engaging workplace that celebrates diversity and fun. **We offer a dynamic environment where excellence is rewarded, your well\-being is a priority, and every day brings a chance to make meaningful connections. Ready for a truly rewarding challenge? We're excited to meet you.**

Make a meaningful difference to patients around the world. Driven by a passion to help patients live healthier and more productive lives, our Sales teams embrace Edwards Lifesciences’ values to build trusting, lasting relationships with medical professionals and industry partners. Your insight and dedication will help deepen and broaden clinical knowledge of our company’s innovative technologies, while creating connections between providers and teams across our businesses to ensure patients receive the highest quality of care.  



  

Dedicated to innovation, our Surgical business unit is focused on identifying and solving critical, unmet needs in cardiac surgery. In understanding the challenges of open\-heart surgery, we partner with surgical teams to deliver modern technologies intended to enhance patients’ quality of life and expand their potential treatment opportunities. It’s our driving force to help patients live longer and healthier lives. Join us and be part of our inspiring journey.  



  

This is an exciting opportunity for a dynamic **Executive Assistant** to join our Surgical Structural Heart business unit, providing high\-level executive partnership to the Senior Vice President of Sales and the Sales Leadership Team.

  

  

**\*\*This is a fully onsite role and will require you to be onsite at our Irvine headquarters 5 days a week\*\***

  

**How you'll make an impact:**

* Manage schedule and calendar of management with attention to accuracy and detail, including keeping Executive informed of calendar changes and change requests
* Use all computer programs relevant to the position to support development of correspondence, presentations, such as tracking and charting metrics data, and to perform data entry and report generation in support of a department, significant organizational group, or executive level management
* Ensure the preparation of information, documents, and logistics for assigned department, significant organizational group, or executive level management Perform general administrative activities including screening and directing phone calls, filing as well as composing and typing general correspondence under limited direction
* Schedule domestic and international travel in compliance with existing policies and procedures, to optimize use of Executive's time and schedule
* Plan and execute meetings and events with some supervision
* Other incidental duties
  

  

**What you'll need (Required):**

  

* H.S. Diploma or equivalent with 6 years of experience directly related experience including executive administrative support
  

  

**What else we look for (Preferred):**

  

* Experience working within the healthcare or medical device industry
* Excellent written and verbal communications skills, including negotiating and relationship management skills
* Ability to manage complex travel arrangements, in keeping with overall time commitments and in support of optimizing time management
* Ability to travel up to 10%
* Extensive knowledge and understanding of Edwards policies, procedures, and administrative requirements
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
* Advanced problem\-solving skills
* Completes tasks in resourceful and effective ways
* Ability to manage internal and external confidential information with utmost discretion
* Works autonomously within established procedures and practices
* Ability to build and maintain strong relationships across the organization to influence and achieve objectives
* Ability to work in a fast paced, dynamic work environment
* Strict attention to detail
* Extensive knowledge and understanding of Edwards policies, procedures, and administrative requirements
* Ability to interact professionally with all organizational levels
* Contacts are across the organization and at all organizational levels, including external contacts that may be at high levels
* Adhere to all company rules and requirements (e.g., pandemic protocols, Environmental Health \& Safety rules) and take adequate control measures in preventing injuries to themselves and others as well as to the protection of environment and prevention of pollution under their span of influence/control
  

  

Aligning our overall business objectives with performance, we offer competitive salaries, performance\-based incentives, and a wide variety of benefits programs to address the diverse individual needs of our employees and their families.
  

  

For California, the base pay range for this position is $72,000 \- $98,000 (highly experienced).
  

  

The pay for the successful candidate will depend on various factors (e.g., qualifications, education, prior experience). Applications will be accepted while this position is posted on our Careers website.

jobs.title: Sales & Marketing Assistant (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

With a legacy spanning four decades, Action Property Management has become the premier choice for homeowner’s association management. Founded in 1984, Action began with a single client and a vision to elevate ethical and professional standards in the HOA industry. Our unwavering commitment to integrity, and professionalism coupled with our core values of excellence, innovation and care for people, continues to define us. Today, as the largest privately owned HOA management company in the West, we proudly serve over 300 communities across 9 offices. Our success is fueled by a team of nearly 900 dedicated team members who genuinely love what they do and are dedicated to helping homeowners thrive and love where they live.



Action Property Management seeks a **Part\-time Sales \& Marketing Assistant** for our **Corporate Office** located in **Irvine, CA.**


**Job Summary**

The Sales \& Marketing Assistant supports Action’s business development and marketing efforts through prospect research, email outreach preparation, content organization, and project coordination. This part\-time role is well suited to someone who enjoys independent, detail\-oriented work and can keep several ongoing projects organized.


**Compensation:** $22 per hour


**Schedule:** Varies; up to 20 hours per week.



### **What You’ll Do (Job Duties)**

**Business Development Research \& Outreach**


* Research prospective community associations in the regions Action serves, identify appropriate contacts, and organize outreach lists in ActiveCampaign.
* Identify associations affected by competitor acquisitions, self\-managed associations, new developments, and communities preparing to come online.
* Research general manager contacts for potential Action Financial Services outreach.
* Maintain accurate solicitation records, including contact details, outreach status, and follow\-up activity.
* Draft tailored email messaging for prospect segments, including new developments, new leads, previously contacted leads, and associations affected by acquisitions.
* Help develop an RFP guidebook and AI\-assisted reference materials so New Business Development managers can respond more efficiently to lengthy RFPs.

  


**Marketing \& Content Support**


* Coordinate the review and management of approximately 40–70 Google and Yelp reviews each month, escalating feedback that requires a response.
* Keep marketing materials current as associations are added or transition out of Action’s portfolio.
* Organize and maintain the internal content library for Action’s 350\+ associations.
* Audit more than 1,000 website photography assets and document their source and copyright information.
* Assist with light content creation and video editing.
* Track and manage podcast accreditation certificates.
* Coordinate the design, ordering, inventory, and distribution of branded giveaway items.
### **Who You Are (Skills/Experience)**


* High school diploma or equivalent required. A college degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field is preferred. Current college students are encouraged to apply.
* Must be able to successfully pass a background check and drug screen
* Strong research, organization, and data\-entry skills, with close attention to detail.
* Clear, professional writing skills and the ability to adapt messaging for different audiences.
* Ability to manage recurring tasks and longer\-term projects independently.
* Comfort working with spreadsheets, shared content libraries, and email marketing platforms; ActiveCampaign experience is a plus.
* Familiarity with AI tools for research or drafting, with the judgment to verify information before use.
* Experience in marketing, sales support, business development, or the community association industry is helpful.
* Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Capable of lifting up to 25 pounds as needed.


**Why You’ll Love Working at Action**

At Action Property Management, we believe in creating an environment where you truly love where you work. We offer competitive pay and ample opportunities for career growth and advancement. Our comprehensive benefits package includes medical, dental, vision, pet insurance, 401(k) with company match, and life and disability support for qualifying team members. We also provide generous paid time off, including vacation hours, sick time, and company\-observed holidays for qualifying team members. We are committed to investing in the infrastructure, technology, training, and tools you need to excel in your role. Our relentless dedication to our company values and culture ensures a workplace where you feel heard, supported, and valued. Join us at Action Property Management and make a meaningful impact.


*Action Property Management is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Supports a Drug Free Workplace. Pursuant to the San Francisco and Los Angeles Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*

jobs.title: Finance Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
ALL APPLICANTS MUST SUBMIT TO INFO@MPA\-NC.COM (**Do Not Apply with Indeed**):

(1\) COMPLETED EMPLOYMENT APPLICATION and (2\) RESUME/CV

***See details of Job Posting and employment application form at https://www.mpa\-nc.com/jobs.aspx***

Please include the title of the position you are applying for in the subject line of the email. You may also mail your resume and cover letter to: Municipal Pooling Authority 1200 Concord Avenue, Suite 100, Concord, CA 94520

**About the Municipal Pooling Authority**

The Municipal Pooling Authority (MPA) is a well\-established and reputable Joint Powers Authority (JPA) established in 1977, to pool municipal assets to provide General Liability coverage and Workers' Compensation coverage for 21 municipalities in Northern California. MPA has grown to include Property, Vehicle Physical Damage, short\-term and long\-term disability, Risk Management, Ergonomics, Employee Benefits, and Employee Wellness services/programs. MPA provides in\-house administration of claims for General Liability, Workers' Compensation, and Vehicle programs, and claims administration services are maintained through Origami, an online claims management system. MPA has continually received Accreditation with Excellence from the California Association of Joint Powers Authorities CAJPA).

Join our team and enjoy MPA’s comprehensive benefits package and defined benefit retirement plan through CalPERS. Some of the benefits package highlights include no\-cost dental and vision coverage for the employee and family, and for medical, there is a minimal employee contribution for Kaiser of $55\.00, with other plans available for an increased share of the cost. MPA provides 14 paid holidays a year, 12 sick days a year, one administration day a year (increasing up to 5 days based on years of service, and 12 days of vacation (increasing based on years of service), and may work remotely up to 4 days a week.

The MPA team has 26 employees who specialize in their area of work, from public administration requirements of pooling to claims administration and program management. The MPA team is a highly collaborative team that takes pride in their area of work and often works together to strategize on moving MPA forward. The team enjoys quarterly team\-building events.

**About the Position: Program Coordinator**

The Program Coordinator is responsible for providing support, coordination, and documentation for Accounts Payable, Payroll, Cash Receipts, and Benefits Program functions at the direction of the Finance Manager.

*Supervision Received and Exercised*

Under direct supervision from the Finance Manager, the Program Coordinator will provide accounts payable, payroll, benefits, cash receipts processing, documentation, support, schedule, coordinate, and facilitate seminars, communications, and other program\-related activities provided by MPA to its Members.

*Essential Duties and Responsibilities*

*Responsibilities and duties may include, but are not limited to, the following:*

**Accounts Payable/Payroll/Cash Receipts**

· Process Accounts Payable, and maintain vendor lists and W9s

· Code member receipts and other Accounts Receivable payments

· Maintain and reconcile petty cash

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator - Cardiology
jobs.description:
The Department of Medicine, Division of Cardiology has developed a clinical research infrastructure within the Division. The goals are to increase industry\-sponsored research, create a system that will assist a physician within the division to operationalize an investigator\-initiated study, and to develop a general cardiology cohort study. The purpose of this position is to carry out the needed tasks as a part of ongoing and future clinical and translational research projects in the Division of Cardiology.

  

Under the supervision of the Clinical Research Supervisor, the Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) will perform duties related to the support and coordination of clinical studies, and may receive training and development to prepare and advance to the next level within the series.

  

CRC duties may include, but will not be limited to, support the management of and coordinate the tasks of single or multiple clinical research studies, depending on their size and complexity; act as intermediary between services and departments while overseeing data and specimen management; manage and report on study results; create, update, and manage databases and comprehensive datasets and reports; help to coordinate staff work schedules to ensure proper coverage; assist with training of Assistant CRCs, and assist Clinical Research Supervisor and/or PI with oversight of other research staff; manage PI’s protocols in the Committee on Human Research online system, as well as renewals and modifications of protocol applications and the implementation of new studies; participate in the review and writing of protocols to ensure institutional review board approval and University compliance; help assure compliance with all relevant regulatory agencies; oversee study data integrity; implement and maintain periodic quality control procedures; interface with departments to obtain UCSF approval prior to study initiation; maintain all regulatory documents; report study progress to investigators; participate in any internal and external audits or reviews of study protocols; and perform other duties as assigned.

  

The Department of Medicine, Division of Cardiology has established a comprehensive, multi\-layered clinical research infrastructure to support and expand the Division’s research mission. This infrastructure supports industry\-sponsored research, facilitates investigator\-initiated studies, and advances a general cardiology cohort study, while offering clear opportunities for professional growth in clinical research operations and leadership.

  

The Cardiology Clinical Research Unit (CCRU) supports 100\-120 active clinical trials. The CCRU research portfolio covers phase I\- IV and post approval trial types and covers a diversity of trials ranging from pharmaceutical, device, preventative, and social behavioral research. Within the Division are sub\-specialty sections for: Adult Congenital Heart Disease; Advanced Heart Failure, Transplant, and Pulmonary Hypertension; Cardiac Electrophysiology; Critical Care Cardiology; Cardio\-Oncology and Immunology; Echocardiography and Cardiac Imaging; General Cardiology, Interventional Cardiology; and Prevention. The Division runs several clinical practices in multiple sites, conducts basic and clinical research, and educates medical students, residents, clinical fellows through ACGME as well as non\-ACGME training programs. In addition, the Division has significant and complex financial and administrative relationships with the Department of Medicine (DOM) and the UCSF Medical Center, as well as large patient care programs in the sections noted above, large clinical, Federal, and privately supported research programs and six faculty laboratories. The Division has 90 full\-time faculty, several non\-faculty academics, 36 clinical fellows, several post\-doctoral research fellows, and approximately 60 research support and administrative staff. The Division currently expends over $22 million per year in pursuit of its clinical, research, training, and service missions. While the Division is primarily split between the Parnassus and Mission Bay campuses, clinical fellows have rotations at the Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital and the San Francisco Veterans Affairs Medical Center.


  
Required Qualifications


* High School Diploma; or equivalent experience/training
* Attention to detail; strong interpersonal skills; excellent, effective verbal and written communication skills to coordinate with subjects, team members, other departments and outside institutions; and the ability to multi\-task in a fast\-paced environment while working with a diverse subject population
* Ability to work well independently, complete projects in a timely manner, and prioritize multiple projects to ensure the completion of essential tasks by deadlines
* Demonstrated ability to exercise tact and discretion in sensitive communications with patients and others. Demonstrated ability in handling a variety of confidential information appropriately.
* Demonstrated positive interpersonal skills and problem solving abilities
* Willing to travel (limited travel for investigator meetings)
  

Preferred Qualifications:


* Two\-year commitment
* Experience in clinical cardiology and clinical/cardiovascular research
* Science, research, or medical background

* In\-depth knowledge of ICH/GCP and FDA requirements for INDs, IDEs, and NDAs

* Knowledge of biospecimen collection, processi

**Marketing Assistant**

  

Founded in 2008, Tutu School is a quaint and whimsical collection of boutique ballet schools designed to foster creativity and joy while encouraging tiny dancers to fully exercise their imagination as well as bodies. With over 100 locations across the U.S. and Canada, Tutu School provides an imaginative curriculum that celebrates the magic of childhood and builds confidence through movement.  

We are Tutu Collective Inc., a proud multi\-unit franchisee of Tutu School. We currently operate 11 Tutu School locations across California, New York and Connecticut. We are hiring for a Marketing Assistant. This position will report directly to the Director of Business Operations.  

**Job Summary**

  

We are looking for a Marketing Assistant who thinks like a marketer and sells like a relationship builder. This role will support local marketing efforts across our regions with a strong focus on events, partnerships, community outreach, and lead generation.  

The goal of this position is not simply to create awareness, but to turn that awareness into action: new families discovering our brand, attending a trial class, and ultimately becoming members of our community.

  

You will be responsible for the full cycle of event and partnership planning, from identifying opportunities and pitching partners to preparing for events, coordinating staffing and logistics, communicating with partners, and following up afterward. You will often be the first interaction a business, organization, influencer, or community partner has with our brand, so professionalism, confidence, and strong communication are essential.

  

This is a highly collaborative role that works closely with our Director of Business Operations, Regional Directors, Social Media Coordinator, Marketing Coordinators, and teaching teams across multiple markets.

* Assist with influencer partnerships, collaborations, and local creator activations.

**What We're Looking For**
* Strong sales and relationship\-building skills with the confidence to initiate conversations and pitch opportunities.

**What Success Looks Like**
Success in this role means creating meaningful local connections that turn into measurable business results. You will help us expand our presence in each market, build strong community partnerships, generate new leads, and ultimately drive more families into our studios through trial classes and memberships.  

We are looking for someone who doesn't wait for opportunities to come to them. You see a local business, event, influencer, or organization and think, \\"How could we partner?\\" Then you confidently reach out, build the relationship, and make it happen

**Hadrian \- Manufacturing the Future**
=======================================


Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full\-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission\-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

  

Following our $1\.37B Series D at a $7\.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory\-as\-a\-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

  

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

  

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

**The Role**
------------


Hadrian is hiring an Experiential Marketing Manager to own every moment where someone meets Hadrian in person. This is the single owner of our events portfolio, from a twelve\-person dinner in a private room to a flagship launch built around a working factory floor.


This role exists because physical experience is our highest\-conviction channel. The people we most want to reach, the engineers building autonomous systems and the machinists and technicians who run them, do not decide where to spend the next five years of their career because of an ad. They decide after they walk a floor, put their hands on a part, and talk to the people doing the work. Your job is to engineer that encounter and then run it at scale across multiple cities.


You will inherit a portfolio that is already in motion and under\-resourced, and you will own it end to end: strategy, calendar, budget, vendors, production, staffing, and the follow\-through that turns a good night into a hire or a customer conversation. This is a builder role with real budget and real autonomy, not a coordinator role executing someone else’s brief.

**Why Now**
-----------


We are scaling our manufacturing footprint across multiple sites and hiring aggressively into the Bay Area and beyond, and our events calendar is about to go from occasional to continuous. Several things are already live: recruiting\-driven dinners and socials, a multi\-month brand and talent campaign anchored in the Bay Area, and a set of factory and site moments tied to new capability launches. The next twelve months include a flagship culminating event whose format is still being decided. You will have a direct hand in that decision rather than inheriting it.
