jobs.title: Account Executive / Account Manager, Data Sales at Kalshi
jobs.description:
**What is Kalshi?**
-------------------


Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.


We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

* Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.
* Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.


Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.

**Role Roadmap**
----------------


We’re looking for an Account Executive / Account Manager to grow Kalshi’s institutional market data business.


You’ll sell Kalshi’s event contract prices, order book data, and historical datasets to hedge funds, asset managers, banks, proprietary trading firms, quantitative investment teams, and fintech companies. You’ll help customers understand how prediction market data can support research, trading strategies, risk management, and financial products.


This role combines new business development with ongoing account ownership. You’ll build pipeline from scratch, run deals from initial outreach through signed contracts, and grow the relationships you bring in. You should be as comfortable discussing a dataset with a quantitative researcher as negotiating a licensing agreement with procurement.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Identify and win new institutional customers for Kalshi’s market data through targeted outbound prospecting, industry relationships, and your existing network.
* Own the full sales cycle, including discovery, product demonstrations, data evaluations, commercial proposals, negotiations, and closing.
* Translate customer needs into clear use cases for event contract prices, order book data, and historical datasets.
* Work directly with quants, portfolio managers, traders, and data engineers to explain data coverage, delivery methods, and integration requirements.
* Structure and negotiate API, data feed, and licensing agreements in partnership with Legal and relevant internal teams.
* Coordinate with Product and Engineering to support customer evaluations, onboarding, and technical integrations.
* Own ongoing account relationships, driving adoption, renewals, and expansion across teams and use cases.
* Maintain a disciplined sales pipeline, accurate forecasts, and clear visibility into customer needs and commercial opportunities.
* Bring customer feedback into decisions about data products, packaging, pricing, and distribution.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* 3–5 years of experience in institutional financial or market data sales or account management.
* A track record of selling to hedge funds, asset managers, banks, proprietary and quantitative trading firms, or fintech companies.
* A hunter mentality: you create opportunities, build pipeline from zero, and take responsibility for getting deals across the finish line.
* Experience selling APIs, data feeds, and data licenses, with an understanding of how institutions evaluate, procure, and consume financial data.
* Fluency in market structure, including exchange mechanics, order books, liquidity, price formation, and how market data supports institutional workflows.
* The ability to hold credible technical and commercial conversations with quantitative researchers, data engineers, investment professionals, and procurement teams.
* Strong negotiation and relationship management skills, with evidence of closing new business and growing existing accounts.
* Comfort working in an environment where you’ll help build the sales process while executing it.
* Willingness to work in person from our New York office  

You’ve got that dawg in you.
  

  

**Especially valuable:**
* A CFA designation or comparable credential demonstrating depth in financial markets.
* Experience at an enterprise financial data provider, exchange data business, or emerging market data vendor.
* An established network of institutional data buyers.
* Institutional sales experience at a crypto or derivatives exchange, or familiarity with prediction markets.  

  

Base salary range: 100k\+ Annually plus equity and benefits

**Our Culture**
---------------


Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets.


Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1\.

**Commitment to Equal Opportunity**
-----------------------------------


Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
### **Job Title**

Customer Success Executive (NYC)
### **Job Description**

**Your role:**

* Overseeing the full lifecycle of strategy, execution, adoption, and value delivery for long\-term strategic partnerships within the Hospital Patient Monitoring (HPM) ecosystem.
* Driving tangible clinical, operational, and financial improvements by working closely with clinical, operational, technical, and executive stakeholders. Ensuring customers achieve full adoption and optimization of the complete monitoring solution—covering bedside and transport monitors, central stations, mobility and notification tools, clinical decision support applications, and interoperability components.
* Developing and managing a unified, data\-driven customer success and outcomes roadmap across both strategic partnerships and traditional HPM service models, while expanding Philips’ presence within the account.
* Collaborating with Sales, Services, and Solutions \& Delivery (S\&SD) teams to guarantee seamless project delivery and partners with Sales to secure renewals, grow existing agreements, transition customers to higher\-value offerings, addendums, and broader Philips portfolio adoption.
Serving as a trusted advisor, linking customer objectives to Philips’ comprehensive monitoring and enterprise portfolio, including diagnostic cardiology, software solutions, interoperability capabilities, and emerging innovations.  
* 

  

**You're the right fit if:**

* You’ve acquired 5\+ years of experience in strategic Customer Relationship Management, Customer Success, Clinical Transformation, or similar. Hospital healthcare or med device industry experience is required.
* Your skills include:
	+ Strong executive influence, a strategic mindset and cross\-functional leadership, both internally and externally.
	+ Knowledge of tools such as Salesforce to evaluate, manage and present KPIs and success planning out to leadership.
	+ A deep understanding of hospital networks and workflows. Hospital patient monitoring knowledge is highly preferred.
* You have a bachelor's or master’s degree (or equivalent) or 9 \+ years of above\-related experience. A current Gainsight certification is a plus.
* You must be able to successfully perform the following minimum Physical, Cognitive and Environmental job requirements with or without accommodation for this position .
You’re an excellent written and verbal communicator, with proficiency in developing presentations and reports.  
* 

**How we work together**

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office\-based teams, this means working in\-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full\-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.  



This is a field role. 50\-75% of local travel is to be expected.  



**About Philips**

We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help improve the lives of others.  



* Learn more about our business .
* Discover our rich and exciting history.
* Learn more about our purpose.
Learn more about our culture.

The pay range for this position in CT, NJ and NY is $131,000 to $208,000\.  



The actual base pay offered may vary within the posted ranges depending on multiple factors including job\-related knowledge/skills, experience, business needs, geographical location, and internal equity.  



In addition, other compensation, such as an annual incentive bonus, sales commission or long\-term incentives may be offered. Employees are eligible to participate in our comprehensive Philips Total Rewards benefits program, which includes a generous PTO, 401k (up to 7% match), HSA (with company contribution), stock purchase plan, education reimbursement and much more. Details about our benefits can be found here .  



At Philips, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top end of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each case.  



**Additional Information**

US work authorization is a precondition of employment. The company will not consider candidates who require sponsorship for a work\-authorized visa, now or in the future.  



Company relocation benefits **will not** be provided for this position. For this position, you must reside in **or** within commuting distance to **New York City.**

jobs.title: Community Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

The Class, founded by Taryn Toomey in 2011, is a somatic movement and wellness practice with studios in New York and Los Angeles and a global digital community. Designed to regulate the nervous system and release stuck energy through physical movement, The Class uses music, movement, and breath to invite students to witness their thoughts, build resilience, and discover a deeper connection to self. In 2026, we launched Field Study—a digital somatic\-education hub available worldwide—taking The Class off the mat.

 **Job Description**  

Field Study is a digital somatic education platform and global community bringing the methodology of The Class into everyday life. The inaugural offering, a 200\-hour Somatic Education Certification, combines self\-paced study, movement practices, live learning, and peer connection.


The Community Manager oversees the day\-to\-day operations and student experience of Field Study, with a primary focus on our Somatic Education Certification cohorts.


This role manages the student lifecycle from registration through certification and alumni engagement across our curriculum, Circle platform, and live programming, while welcoming students into an expanding ecosystem of learning and community.


Partnering with the Director of Field Study, the Community Manager builds scalable systems, executes engagement strategies, and translates student feedback into continuous improvements to evolve offerings as the program grows.


This is a collaborative, hands\-on role for a fast\-paced environment requiring strong project management, customer experience skills, and a passion for building community.

**What You'll Do**

**Community Management \& Student Experience**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for all participants throughout their lifecycle.
* Deliver timely, thoughtful, and on\-brand student support across the custom\-branded app (hosted on Circle), email, and community channels.
* Guide the student experience from onboarding through certification and alumni engagement, driving participation and long\-term connection.
* Moderate the Field Study community spaces and newsfeed, fostering an engaging online environment for thousands of members.
* Collaborate with the Director of Field Study to execute engagement strategies that boost course completion and satisfaction.

**Program Operations \& Project Managemen**

* Build and maintain operational systems, including project trackers, workflows, templates, and standard operating procedures.
* Own Circle administration end\-to\-end: platform structure, member access, courses, events, content organization, and automations for the somatic education cohorts and future spaces and trainings.
* Coordinate the Field Study content calendar, scheduling course releases, live sessions, teacher communications, and certification milestones for overlapping cohorts.
* Manage student communications and automated email/message journeys across Circle and Klaviyo.
* Maintain accurate student records, enrollment rosters, and program documentation.
* Manage cross\-functional deliverables with internal teams to keep projects on schedule.

**Registration \& Fellowship Management**

* Partner with Marketing on launch campaigns for new cohorts and offerings, sharing student testimonials, FAQs, and enrollment insights.
* Manage the registration inbox, guiding prospective students through enrollment with personalized communication and strategic follow\-up.
* Oversee Fellowship administration, including application tracking, selection, communication, coupon creation, and student onboarding.
* Analyze registration barriers and recurring inquiries to help inform enrollment strategy.

**Live Programming \& Alumni Engagement**

* Coordinate logistics and scheduling for Opening Circles, live calls, mentor groups, closing ceremonies, and alumni programming.
* Support teachers and group facilitators with materials, meeting prep, feedback collection, and post\-session follow\-up.
* Promptly upload and organize course recordings, materials, and resources.
* Implement AI tools and automated workflows to enhance efficiency and elevate the student experience.
* Track student progress toward certification requirements and issue completion certificates.
* Nurture an active alumni community through ongoing events, programming, and networking opportunities.

**Student Feedback \& Program Development**

* Design and administer surveys to measure onboarding, course experience, engagement, and satisfaction.
* Monitor participation metrics across coursework, live sessions, and community spaces.
* Synthesize student feedback and participation data into actionable insights and program recommendations.
* Maintain a self\-service FAQ and help center to streamline student support.

 **Qualifications** **Who You Are**

* Highly organized and detail\-oriented, with proven ability to manage multiple projects and timelines.
* A warm, empathetic relationship builder with strong judgment and high customer service standards.
* An excellent communicator capable of translating complex information clearly and warmly.
* Proactive, adaptable, and resourceful—comfortable navigating ambiguity and solving problems in a fast\-paced environment.
* Technologically savvy and comfortable building workflows, learning new platforms, and improving existing systems.
* Tech\-savvy with experience optimizing workflows and platforms.
* Passionate about spreading awareness and access to The Class’s mission and methodology.

**What You've Done**

* 2\+ years managing complex projects, workstreams, and organizational systems.
* Experience overseeing online communities, educational programs, or high\-engagement membership environments.
* Proven success coordinating live programming, workshops, or virtual events.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


We seek an analytical thinker who has experience developing, executing, and refining growth strategies to lead a newly created ad sales strategy and planning function. Advertisers leverage Amazon’s data\-driven insights, engaging creative formats, and diverse placements to reach the right audiences to grow their brand. Our ad sales team informs, educates, and supports advertisers across six continents. Success in this role requires defining ambitious goals regarding how our sales team can better serve advertisers drawing on best practices across Amazon and the digital advertising industry, developing internal relationships to align product, finance, recruiting, and account management teams on inputs needed to hit these goals, and inspecting and removing blockers as teams execute on these goals.  

  

A qualified candidate thrives in articulating complex concepts to cross functional audiences using internal metrics, voice of the customer, and industry trends to support recommendations. widget: Full time

**Design Your Future at PVH**


Design Development Coordinator \- PVH
The Design Development Coordinator drives the product development and commercialization process working with the internal/external cross functional partners (Design, Merch Planning, Raw Materials, Technical Design, Supply, Hub, Factory, Sales and Operations) to deliver product that meets business requirements for quality, aesthetic and price. The Design Development Coordinator establishes consistent communication with the Hub teams /Factories regarding concerns on proper sample execution throughout the development process, and mitigates challenges upfront.

  

  

**What You'll Do:**

  

  

* Partner with Design for seasonal development and new product launches
* Work with Design to initiate flash cost request; maintain cost request tracking log for follow up and receipt of costing information from Hub office
* Work with Design to create tech packages in PLM for initial season set up , ie, bill of material, model, and packaging BOM
* Lead initiatives that support tech pack accuracy to drive future data driven systems forward
* Initiate all sample requests
* Create Line Sheet with images in Visulon for Line Adoption \& Line Finalization milestone meetings
* Work with 3rd party vendor for production of selling tools – swatch card/references
* Partner with RM, QA, and Tech teams to ensure a seasonal risk assessment is complete
* Facilitate \& participate in seasonal product reviews to evaluate sample execution and alignment to tech pack requirements
* Oversee Late Add process and Line Adoption \& Finalization meetings
* Attend fit sessions to review details needed to prepare block/make detail requests
* Initiate and track style development from concept through production, ensuring all approvals are met per calendar deadlines
* Responsible for all daily communication with overseas offices
* Drive product development calendar adherence
* Build effective relationships with internal partners in Design, Sales, Merchandise Planning, and Supply and Operations to help execute cross functional synergy and collaboration
  

  

**What You'll Bring:**

  

  

* 1\-3 years’ experience recommended in product development, merchandising or other related work experience
* Strong organizational skills
* Strong sense of teamwork and ability to multitask
* Work independently
* Excellent communication skills
* Detail oriented and ability to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment
* High energy level and must work well under pressure
  

  

**This position is not eligible for sponsorship.**

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**ABOUT CLAIMSORTED**


At ClaimSorted, we're building a more resilient world \- one where people and businesses have the confidence to pursue bigger opportunities. We're doing this by transforming how insurance delivers on its most important promise: helping people and businesses recover when things go wrong.


The world's largest insurers and Fortune 500 companies work with us to handle claims and manage risk more efficiently, so they \- and the people they protect \- can move forward with confidence.


Backed by Y Combinator, Atomico and Eurazeo, we grew 10x in the past year \- and we're just getting started.

**THE ROLE**


We're looking for a Sales Development Representative to join our founding GTM team and build the pipeline that fuels our next wave of growth. You'll be the first conversation most of our future customers have with ClaimSorted \- finding the right people at the largest insurance and Fortune 500 companies in the world, and giving them a reason to listen.


Success in this role isn't measured by quota alone. You'll need to deeply understand each prospect's business to open a real conversation, not just book a meeting.

* **Build and run outbound campaigns** targeting the largest insurance and Fortune 500 companies in the world \- research accounts, identify the right stakeholders, and find your way in
* **Own top\-of\-funnel, end\-to\-end** \- from first outreach to a booked, qualified meeting handed to our Account Executives
* **Get creative across channels** \- email, phone, LinkedIn, whatever it takes to cut through and get a response from people who get pitched constantly
* **Qualify relentlessly** \- make sure every meeting you book is one worth having, so our AEs spend their time on real opportunities, not noise
* **Help shape our outbound playbook** \- feed what you learn from hundreds of conversations back into how we message and target, so the motion gets sharper as we scale
* **Get real product influence** \- work directly with Claims and Product; what you hear from prospects changes how we position what we build next


We love working together in the office, so this is a full\-time, in\-office role in our New York City office. We're a high\-intensity team and often put in significant time and effort, with some people working on weekends, because we believe great outcomes come from doing the work well.

**WHO YOU ARE**


We care more about hunger and grit than years on a resume. You might be a recent grad with an unreasonable work ethic, or someone early in their sales career who's ready to prove they can go further, faster.

* **Strong written and verbal communicator** \- you can get a stranger to reply to a cold email or pick up the phone
* **Comfortable with high volume, high rejection** \- you stay sharp and motivated through a lot of "no" on the way to "yes"
* **Coachable and fast\-learning** \- you take feedback on your outreach and get better week over week, not quarter over quarter
* **Organized and process\-driven** \- you keep a high\-volume pipeline clean and nothing falls through the cracks
* **Ambitious about where this leads** \- you want this to be the start of a sales career, not a one\-year stop

**OUR VALUES**

* **Move Fast** – Act decisively, iterate quickly, optimize for momentum.
* **Always Overdeliver** – We exceed expectations in everything we do.
* **Think Customer\-First, Always** – The customer experience drives every decision.
* **Challenge the Status Quo** – We innovate relentlessly and never settle for 'good enough.'
* **Say It How It Is** – Transparency and direct communication build trust.

**COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS**

* **$150k OTE**
* Equity participation: stock options as an early\-stage team member
* Medical, dental and vision insurance for you and your dependents
* 401(k) with 4% company match
* 20 Days annual PTO
* 30 days work from anywhere annually
* Accelerated promotion track in a high\-growth environment


Compensation Range: $0 \- $150K

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
Koyfin is a fast growing fintech company building a powerful, intuitive analytics platform used by financial advisors and individual investors to research ideas, manage portfolios, and grow their businesses. We believe every investor deserves world\-class research tools without the complexity or price tag of legacy platforms.


Our impact so far:  

One of the fastest\-growing platforms for financial advisors, driven by product\-led growth  

Recognized by users as a top\-rated investment solution on G2  

Rated as the top research platform for user satisfaction in the Kitces survey, the largest survey in the advisor industry

**About the Role**


Koyfin has over 60,000 financial advisors using the platform and over 800,000 registered users. Most of them found us on their own. Your job is to turn that product\-led momentum into revenue by reaching the right advisors at the right moment and booking qualified meetings for our Account Executives.


You'll be one of our first in\-house SDRs, joining a lean sales org. You own the human side of outreach: research, calls, and LinkedIn. You'll run time\-boxed tests across a 45\-day multi\-touch journey of calls, emails, and LinkedIn.


This is a ground\-floor seat. Every motion here has defined success and quit criteria, and what you learn on the phones directly shapes how we build and scale the team.

**What You'll Do**


This role is for someone who is competitive, hungry and here to win. We set aggressive goals and we’re looking for people who want to beat them. The pace is fact, the work is hard. If that energizes you, you’ll fit in.

* Run high\-quality outbound calls and LinkedIn outreach to users and new registrants
* Qualify prospects and book meetings for Account Executives, with clean, well\-documented handoffs
* Work with RevOps on prospect lists, targeting, and sequencing
* Research prospects (advisors, RIAs, and IBD reps) using product\-usage signals and firm data
* Log every activity in HubSpot so the team can measure what's working
* Share what you hear from the market (objections, use cases, competitor mentions) to sharpen messaging and targeting
* Carry a revenue\-based quota tied to pipeline you source that converts to closed\-won business

**What We're Looking For**

* 1 to 3 years of experience as an SDR or BDR, ideally in B2B SaaS, with a track record of hitting or beating quota
* Comfortable on the phone: you like calling and can hold a real conversation with a busy professional
* Experience with multi\-channel outreach (phone, email, LinkedIn) and a CRM (HubSpot a plus)
* Strong written and verbal communication, and the discipline to keep a CRM clean
* Curious, coachable, and energized by testing and iterating rather than running a fixed script
* Interest in markets and investing. Experience selling to financial advisors, RIAs, or financial services is a plus, not required
* Able to start immediately and work hybrid from or near Great Neck, NY / NYC

**Why Join Koyfin**

* Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a competitive salary, equity options, and a comprehensive benefits package.
* Career Path: Early SDRs get direct coaching from the Head of Sales and a clear line of sight into how the team grows.
* Innovative Environment: Be part of a fast\-growing company at the forefront of financial technology, moving quickly to release new products.
* Dynamic Culture: Customer First, Humility \& Respect, Teamwork, Continuous Improvement, and Getting Things Done.
* Impactful Work: Work with a small, talented team where your contributions directly impact the product and the community it serves.
* Industry\-Leading Product: Sell a product users already love, disrupting the financial analytics space through product\-led growth.
* Efficiency and Growth: Koyfin is cash flow positive and emphasizes doing more with less.


At Koyfin, impact comes with responsibility. We expect independent thinking, sound judgment, and ownership of outcomes. We value clear communication, intellectual honesty, and continuous improvement. You’ll be trusted to make decisions, contribute thoughtfully, and raise the standard of the work around you.


Our hiring process is thoughtful and efficient, typically including an HR conversation, role\-specific interviews, and a final discussion with leadership.


Koyfin is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.


Compensation Range: $75K \- $115K

jobs.description:
**Description**


Join Syneos Health in partnership with a large Biopharmaceutical company as a Pharmaceutical Sales Representative (PSR). Become a part of a fast\-paced and challenging environment where our compassion and dedication drive us to meet the unique needs and goals of our customers. The PSR role is responsible for building relationships with recognized experts, healthcare providers (HCPs) and prioritized stakeholders.

**The successful PSR will:**

* Achieve and/or exceed targeted sales goals in an assigned territory by developing, implementing, and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key accounts with the goal of maximizing sales
* Identify key influencers and achieve designated customer interaction expectations with a focus on top target customers
* Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action
* Deliver clinical brand specific presentations of product(s) to physicians and other appropriate health care professionals
* Develop a complete understanding of the health care delivery system within each assigned customer, including the physician hierarchy, key pharmacy personnel, clinical nursing staff, etc.
* Develop deep product and competitor knowledge and understanding of local and regional market trends
* Analyze local trends, identifying long and short\-term goals to craft a strong product business plan
* Collaborate and partner with peers in the sales organization, brand team and other support partners to deliver an extraordinary customer experience
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner
* Execute the company brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area
* Participation in training and development programs
* Leverage AI\-driven insights and digital engagement tools to personalize healthcare provider interactions and improve customer experience.
* Adapt to emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence and automation tools, to enhance productivity, customer engagement, and business outcomes.
* Maintain adherence and compliance with all corporate, industry policies and procedures

**Essential Requirements:**

* BA/BS degree required, Life Sciences preferred
* Business to business sales experience or internship experience and/or sales degree or 2\+ years of pharmaceutical experience
* Ability to identify key decision makers, develop positive relationships and strong customer dedication and influence prescribing habits
* Ability to learn, apply, and communicate products and disease states
* Proven track record of success in exceeding results
* Team player who can also work independently, highly collaborative and motivated to succeed
* Strong communication, business analytics and account management skills
* Strong digital acumen with an interest in adopting innovative technologies, including artificial intelligence, to drive performance and operational efficiency.

**Desired Requirements:**

* Cardiovascular Experience


The annual base salary for this position is **$60,000 – $90,000**. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include a company car or car allowance and eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and/or individual performance.

By joining one of our commercial teams, you’re empowered to succeed with the support, resources, and autonomy that you need. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Syneos Health has launched more sales teams in the last 5 years across all major therapeutic areas than the top 25 pharma companies combined. Join our game\-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients. Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients’ lives around the world.


Work Here Matters Everywhere \| How are you inspired to change lives?

jobs.description:
**Crown Disaster Management — Alpharetta, GA** Full\-Time \| Office\-Based

About Crown Disaster Management

Crown Disaster Management is a full\-service disaster restoration company serving residential and commercial clients across North and Central Georgia. We handle water damage mitigation, fire and smoke restoration, mold remediation, storm damage, contents cleaning, pack\-out, and complete structural reconstruction. As we grow, we're looking for a Job Coordinator to help keep our operations running smoothly from the moment a new loss comes in.

The Role

As a Job Coordinator at Crown, you'll be the first point of contact when a new job comes in. You'll intake new losses, enter job information into Dash, contact homeowners to introduce Crown and schedule the initial assessment, and push job details to our estimators and field crews so everyone is set up for a smooth response.

This is an office\-based role that sits at the center of our operations — you'll be talking to homeowners, coordinating with the field team, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks from intake to kickoff.

Responsibilities

* Intake new job assignments and enter all relevant information accurately into Dash
* Contact homeowners promptly to introduce Crown Disaster Management and schedule the initial site visit
* Communicate job details, schedules, and updates to estimators, project managers, and field crews
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date job records throughout the intake and scheduling process
* Follow up with homeowners and internal team members to confirm appointments and address questions
* Monitor incoming job assignments and prioritize response based on urgency
* Support the operations team with administrative coordination and job file management
* Provide professional, empathetic customer service to homeowners during a stressful time

Requirements

* Minimum 2 years of experience in a coordinator, dispatcher, or customer service role
* Experience with Dash or similar job management software — required
* Strong customer service skills — you'll be speaking with homeowners who have just experienced a loss
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
* Clear and professional written and verbal communication
* Ability to manage multiple active jobs and priorities simultaneously
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and general computer skills

What We Offer

* Competitive salary commensurate with experience
* Full\-time, permanent position
* Paid time off
* Stable, growing company with consistent job volume
* Direct access to leadership and opportunity to grow with the business

How to Apply

Submit your resume and a brief description of your coordination and customer service experience to.

Crown Disaster Management is an equal opportunity employer.

Benefits:

* The PI retains responsibility for scientific and strategic direction, substantive project decisions, approval of expenditures and deliverables, and management of scientific collaborations.
* Prior experience navigating Emory University administrative systems and processes is strongly preferred, particularly experience with contracting, procurement, payments, research administration, international shipping/import\-export processes, and coordination across University administrative offices.

jobs.title: Video Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**
---------------------


Bring creative ideas to life by keeping every detail of video production moving forward. As a Video Production Coordinator, you will support projects spanning brand campaigns, corporate storytelling, multimedia event content, and live productions. You will partner with the Video team, broader Production team, internal creative partners, clients, vendors, and freelancers to coordinate work from early planning through final delivery.


This role is a strong fit for someone who is highly organized, detail\-oriented, proactive, and excited to build a career in video or creative production. You will gain hands\-on experience across pre\-production, on\-site production, post\-production, and the operational work that helps projects stay on schedule, within budget, and aligned with their goals.

**Things You Will Do**
----------------------

* Coordinate video project schedules, timelines, deliverables, status updates, and production documentation using Workfront and other team tools.
* Support pre\-production planning by preparing call sheets, coordinating travel and filming logistics, and helping secure crew, locations, equipment rentals, vendors, and production resources.
* Communicate with internal teams, clients, freelancers, vendors, and crew members to keep project details clear, organized, and moving forward.
* Provide on\-site support for filming and live productions, including equipment preparation, production setup, crew coordination, shoot notes, releases, approvals, expense tracking, and production logs.
* Coordinate post\-production review cycles, stakeholder feedback, revisions, approvals, file organization, media archiving, and final deliverables.
* Track vendor estimates, invoices, project expenses, contracts, deal memos, NDAs, and freelancer documentation, escalating questions or discrepancies as needed.
* Maintain organized project files, production records, vendor information, and asset libraries to support efficient handoffs and long\-term accessibility.
* Identify practical ways to improve production workflows, documentation, and operational consistency.
**What You Will Bring**
-----------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in film, communications, media production, marketing, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* One to three years of experience in video production, creative production, project coordination, or a related field.
* A foundational understanding of video production, post\-production workflows, and common production practices.
* Strong organizational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, timelines, and deliverables.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with clients, vendors, freelancers, crew members, and internal teams.
* Strong attention to detail, reliable follow\-through, and a proactive, solutions\-oriented approach.
* Experience supporting production logistics and familiarity with camera, audio, lighting, and equipment setup needs.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Teams and familiarity with Workfront or a similar project management platform.
* Basic knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro and familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite workflows are helpful; a portfolio or relevant work samples are welcome.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-moving production environment.
* Willingness and ability to travel as needed for on\-site video production support and to work the time necessary to meet project deadlines.

jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

  

Georgia Tech prides itself on its technological resources, collaborations, high\-quality student body, and its commitment to building an outstanding and diverse community of learning, discovery, and creation. We strongly encourage applicants whose values align with our institutional values, as outlined in our Strategic Plan. These values include academic excellence, diversity of thought and experience, inquiry and innovation, collaboration and community, and ethical behavior and stewardship. Georgia Tech has policies to promote a healthy work\-life balance and is aware that attracting faculty may require meeting the needs of two careers.


About Georgia Tech


Georgia Tech is a top\-ranked public research university situated in the heart of Atlanta, a diverse and vibrant city with numerous economic and cultural strengths. The Institute serves more than 45,000 students through top\-ranked undergraduate, graduate, and executive programs in engineering, computing, science, business, design, and liberal arts. Georgia Tech's faculty attracted more than $1\.4 billion in research awards this past year in fields ranging from biomedical technology to artificial intelligence, energy, sustainability, semiconductors, neuroscience, and national security. Georgia Tech ranks among the nation's top 20 universities for research and development spending and No. 1 among institutions without a medical school.
  

Georgia Tech's Mission and Values


Georgia Tech's mission is to develop leaders who advance technology and improve the human condition. The Institute has nine key values that are foundational to everything we do:


1\. Students are our top priority.


2\. We strive for excellence.


3\. We thrive on diversity.


4\. We celebrate collaboration.


5\. We champion innovation.


6\. We safeguard freedom of inquiry and expression.


7\. We nurture the wellbeing of our community.


8\. We act ethically.


9\. We are responsible stewards.


Over the next decade, Georgia Tech will become an example of inclusive innovation, a leading technological research university of unmatched scale, relentlessly committed to serving the public good; breaking new ground in addressing the biggest local, national, and global challenges and opportunities of our time; making technology broadly accessible; and developing exceptional, principled leaders from all backgrounds ready to produce novel ideas and create solutions with real human impact.


**Department Information**
--------------------------

  

The College of Computing was established in 1990 as the first such College at a public university and the second in the United States. Since that time, the college has grown into a world\-class leader in research and education. The graduate CS program is currently ranked 6th nationally, and the undergraduate program is ranked 5th, by U.S. News and World Report. The College consists of five Schools that provide specialized and general computing education to the entire campus. With over 16\-degree programs, including its world\-renowned online MS in CS, we believe the College is the largest Computing unit in the United States and, as such, one of the largest producers of computationalists at all levels and across all demographic backgrounds. The College is a part of the Georgia Institute of Technology, a unit of the University System of Georgia, and is primarily located in the heart of Atlanta, Georgia.

High school diploma, GED Certificate or Vocational School Diploma

jobs.title: National Account Manager
jobs.description:
***Swisher stands at the forefront of innovation in the consumer products industry, blending a legacy of excellence with a forward\-thinking approach. Established in 1861, the family\-owned company has evolved into a trailblazer, renowned for its iconic Swisher Sweets cigars, cutting\-edge American\-made Rogue and Ammo modern oral nicotine products, and the premium Drew Estate cigar collection, which features ACID, Liga Privada, and Undercrown. Poised for the future, Swisher is redefining traditional categories with Volt\+Co \-home to groundbreaking products such as Mojo Energy Pouches. Swisher is also home to more than two dozen American\-made, non\-combustible tobacco brands under the Helme Tobacco Co. umbrella. Based in Jacksonville, Florida, with operations spanning the U.S., the Dominican Republic, and Nicaragua, Swisher continues to lead through innovation, setting new benchmarks in quality and creativity. Learn more at swisher.com.***

  


**Primary Purpose:**



The National Account Manager manages Swisher’s key retail and wholesale accounts within Grocery and Dollar Channel and their respective distributors. This role drives volume, revenue, and share growth through strategic selling, relationship development, and flawless execution of customer business plans.


**Key** **Responsibilities**

* Manage assigned national accounts to achieve volume, revenue, and profit targets.
* Develop and execute customer business plans aligned with channel strategies and account\-specific objectives.
* Lead Joint Business Planning (JBP) and collaborate with buyers and category managers to strengthen long\-term partnerships.
* Execute insight\-driven selling that integrates category, shopper, and financial data to inform recommendations and secure new opportunities.
* Manage pricing, promotions, and trade investment to ensure ROI and budget compliance.
* Coordinate sell\-in and activation of new products, innovation, and promotional programs across the account base.
* Partner with Category Management, Shopper Insights, and Marketing to deliver tailored customer solutions that enhance brand and category performance.
* Monitor sales performance, promotional execution, and merchandising compliance through standardized scorecards and performance tracking.
* Participate in customer meetings, industry events, and trade shows to strengthen relationships and drive business visibility.
* Provide timely reporting, analysis, and insights on account performance, opportunities, and competitive activity.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

  


**Qualifications:**


***Required***


* 7\+ years of progressive sales or account management experience in consumer packaged goods or related industries.
* Proven success in managing large, complex national or regional retail accounts with measurable sales and share growth, with an emphasis on Grocery/Dollar channels.
* Experience in developing and executing customer business plans and trade programs.
* Strong financial acumen with experience managing pricing, promotions, and trade budgets.
* Proficiency with sales analytics tools, CRM platforms, and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders.
* Must be at least 21 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license.

  


*Education**:* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field.

  


*Travel:* This position requires up to 30\-50% travel, including overnight stays, based on the geographic area and customer needs.

  


***Preferred***

* Experience in consumer goods, tobacco, or regulated industries.
* Familiarity with revenue growth management, Power BI, Nielsen, or relevant analytics platforms.
* Advanced knowledge of distributor incentive programs and performance scorecards.


**Physical Requirements:**


* Must be able to lift, carry, push, or pull materials weighing up to (or exceeding) 45 lbs
* Capability to navigate convenience stores, warehouses, and retail environments, including climbing ladders and working in tight or confined spaces
* Ability to sit and/or stand for prolonged periods


**What we offer:**


* Base salary and bonus program
* Company vehicle for business and personal use
* Medical, dental, vision, life insurance effective on date of hire
* Generous 401(k) Plan
* Defined Contribution Plan
* Paid vacation and paid holidays
* Tuition reimbursement

jobs.description:
**About Ceribell**



Ceribell is a medical technology company focused on transforming the diagnosis and management of patients with serious neurological conditions. The Ceribell System is a novel, point\-of\-care electroencephalography ("EEG") platform specifically designed to address the unmet needs of patients in the acute care setting, and is being used in hundreds of community hospitals, large academic facilities and major IDN's across the country. Our entire team is driven by a shared commitment to transforming the landscape of critical care through our rapid seizure detection technology, come join the movement!


The Strategic Account Manager plays a critical role in driving Ceribell's growth across key regional IDNs, academic medical centers, and large health systems. This individual contributor position focuses on securing system\-wide adoption and expanding utilization of Ceribell's rapid EEG technology across multiple care settings.



Success in this role requires a strategic mindset, the ability to navigate complex decision\-making structures, and a deep understanding of hospital operations. The Strategic Account Manager partners closely with Territory Managers and cross\-functional teams to ensure Ceribell's solutions are effectively positioned, adopted, and integrated within customer workflows.

* Cultivate executive\-level relationships within regional IDNs and health systems, engaging key stakeholders across clinical, administrative, and supply chain functions.

* Support new account onboarding by collaborating with clinical and implementation teams to ensure smooth integration and high user adoption.

*Must reside within the assigned region and be willing to travel up to 60%.*


**Compensation: $185,000 Base $325,000 OTE**

A candidate's final salary offer will be based on their skills, education, work location and experience, and thus it may differ from the posted range. Compensation may also include bonuses consistent with Ceribell's corporate compensation plan. Note, the above description is not all\-encompassing and Ceribell reserves the right to change or modify job duties and assignments at any time.


**In addition to your base compensation, Ceribell offers eligible employees the following:**


* Performance\-based incentive compensation (varies by role)
* Equity opportunities
* 100% Employer paid Health Benefits for Employees

* 100% paid Life and Long\-Term Disability Insurance
* 401(k) with a generous company match
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with a discount
* Monthly cell phone stipend
* Flexible paid time off
* 13 Paid Holidays \+ 3 Company Wellness Days
* Excellent parental leave policy
* Fantastic culture with tremendous career advancement opportunities
* Joining a mission\-minded organization!


**Application Deadline:** Ongoing

**The Opportunity**

  

Vertis Wealth and Law is seeking a poised, discreet and unusually strong writer who can represent the firm  

professionally on the phone and turn complex approved topics into clear first drafts. This internship  

combines client experience with disciplined brand\-content support.

 **What You Will Do**

  

* Provide scheduled phone and reception backup using approved greetings, verification, routing, and  

escalation procedures.
* Capture complete, accurate messages and protect confidential information.
* Research, outline, draft, and revise approved blog topics using credible sources.
* Write for an educated audience without giving individualized financial, legal, tax, or investment advice.
* Maintain source logs and submit all content for editorial and compliance approval; interns do not  

publish directly.

  


**What You Will Learn**

  

* Professional client communication, message accuracy, escalation judgment, and office discretion.
* Research, source evaluation, editing, brand voice, and compliant financial\-services content  

development.
* How client service, wealth management, legal services, tax planning, and marketing operate within  

one firm.

  


**Who Should Apply**

  

* You sound warm and composed on the phone and write clearly without filler.
* You are highly accurate with names, messages, deadlines, sources, and confidential information.
* You can accept detailed edits and improve a draft without becoming defensive.
* You understand that credible content requires research and review—not merely fast production.
* Sophomores, juniors, and seniors may apply; reliable in\-office attendance is essential.

Communications, public relations, journalism, English, professional writing, marketing, digital media,  

advertising, business administration, psychology, hospitality, finance, financial planning, accounting,  

economics, or pre\-law. Strong writing samples and service judgment matter more than a particular major.

Submit a resume, two writing samples, and a short response describing how you would handle a caller asking  

a question you are not authorized to answer. Selected applicants will complete a phone audition, message



taking simulation, editing exercise, and structured interview.  

Vertis Wealth and Law is committed to equal employment opportunity. Employment decisions are based on  

qualifications, performance, business needs, and applicable law.

Full\-time employment is not promised. Strong performers may be considered for Client Experience

separate six\-week Account Manager training and assessment bridge.

We are seeking a highly motivated and results\-driven Convenience Channel Sales Account Manager to join our sales team. You will act as the primary point of contact for accounts within the convenience channel, ensuring product placement, competitive positioning, and effective category management and merchandising. * Account Management: Develop and manage relationships with key accounts in the convenience channel, including convenience stores, travel centers, truck stops, and wholesalers. Identify customer needs and tailor solutions that drive sales and profitability.
* Sales Strategy: Develop and implement sales strategies for the convenience channel to increase revenue, expand market share, and achieve sales targets. Identify opportunities for growth and work proactively to maximize performance within the channel.

* Customer Support: Provide exceptional customer service by addressing any issues, inquiries, or concerns. Proactively communicate with internal and external resources to resolve problems quickly and efficiently to maintain positive relationships.
* Sales Reporting \& Forecasting: Track and report on sales performance, market trends, and competitor activity. Utilize data to forecast sales, plan promotional efforts, and adjust strategies as needed.
* Collaboration: Work closely with cross\-functional teams, including marketing, supply chain, and operations, to ensure smooth execution of sales plans, promotions, and product distribution. Work with any external rep agencies to achieve channel and customer goals.
* Market Insights \& Trends: Stay up to date on the latest industry trends, competitor activities, and customer preferences. Provide feedback to the broader sales and marketing teams on customer needs and market dynamics.

jobs.title: Partner Success Manager- Account Growth & Inside Sales
jobs.description:
**Partner Success Manager – Account Growth \& Inside Sales**


Community Tax is looking for a **Partner Success Manager** to manage, develop, and grow relationships with our referral partners.


This is a relationship\-driven **account management role with a consultative sales component**. Our referral partners have already chosen to work with Community Tax, so you won't spend your day cold calling strangers looking for the next prospect.


Instead, you'll help partners become successful with Community Tax—building relationships, increasing referral activity, solving problems, re\-engaging less\-active accounts, and identifying additional solutions that can provide value to their businesses.


**This isn't a traditional high\-pressure sales role—and it isn't a traditional customer service role.**


We're looking for someone in between: **a relationship builder with commercial instincts.**


**What You'll Do**


You'll manage an assigned portfolio of Community Tax referral partners and serve as their primary day\-to\-day point of contact.


You'll:


* Onboard new partners and help them successfully make their first referral.
* Build strong relationships and understand each partner's business and referral needs.
* Conduct regular check\-ins and proactive account outreach.
* Monitor referral activity, engagement, and overall account health.
* Recognize when activity slows or changes, find out why, and work to re\-engage the partner.
* Identify opportunities to increase referrals and expand productive partner relationships.
* Answer questions, solve problems, and coordinate with internal teams when assistance is needed.
* Introduce additional Community Tax products and solutions when they can provide genuine value.
* Maintain accurate account activity, notes, and follow\-up within our CRM.


**The Person We're Looking For**


The strongest Partner Success Managers understand that **relationship building and sales aren't competing responsibilities**.


You build trust, ask good questions, understand what a partner needs, recognize opportunities, recommend appropriate solutions, and aren't afraid to ask for the business when the solution makes sense.


You don't need to be a hard\-closing, commission\-driven salesperson to succeed here. But you **do** need to be comfortable with sales, persuasion, business conversations, measurable goals, and being accountable for growth.


**You may be a strong fit if you:**


* Build rapport and credibility naturally.
* Enjoy developing ongoing business relationships.
* Are proactive rather than waiting for someone to ask for help.
* Listen well and ask effective questions.
* Notice changes in account activity and want to understand why.
* Can recommend a solution without making the relationship feel transactional.
* Are comfortable discussing products, money, business needs, and opportunities.
* Can address questions or objections and confidently move a conversation toward action.
* Stay organized while managing multiple accounts and follow\-ups.
* Take ownership and follow through on commitments.


Your previous title might be **Account Manager, Inside Sales Representative, Customer Success Manager, Partner Success Manager, Relationship Manager, Business Development Representative**, or something completely different.


We're more interested in whether you've developed the right combination of relationship and commercial skills.


**Compensation \& Incentives**


**Base Salary: $50,000**


In addition to base salary, Partner Success Managers are eligible for:


* **10% – 20% annual performance bonus opportunity**, paid quarterly based on applicable partner performance measures.
* **CTAX Intelligence revenue incentive** on qualifying revenue collected within onboarded and assigned accounts.
* Additional **Phase One sales incentives** during the March–May tax\-season sales assignment.


**Consultative Solution Sales**


As part of the role, you'll be trained to introduce, demonstrate, and sell **CTAX Intelligence**, our subscription\-based SaaS transcript solution designed specifically for our target market.


This is consultative selling: understand the partner's business, identify a need, demonstrate the solution, answer questions, address objections, and confidently ask for the business when there's a good fit.


The goal isn't to turn every conversation into a sales pitch. It's to know your partners well enough to recognize when Community Tax has something that can genuinely help them—and to be comfortable having that conversation.


**A Seasonal Change of Pace**


From approximately **March through May**, Partner Success Managers also help Community Tax's consumer sales organization manage increased tax\-season demand.


You'll receive comprehensive Phase One tax resolution sales training and work with qualified prospective clients to understand their needs, explain our Phase One service, and help appropriate clients enroll.


You'll also have an opportunity to earn additional sales incentives during this seasonal assignment.


After tax season, your primary focus returns to your referral partner portfolio.


**Qualifications**


* 2\+ years of relevant experience in **account management, inside sales, partner or customer success, relationship management, business development**, or a comparable client\-facing role preferred.
* Strong relationship\-building, verbal, and written communication skills.
* Comfortable with **consultative selling and persuasive business conversations**.
* Strong organization, prioritization, and follow\-through.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts, priorities, and commitments.
* Comfortable using CRM technology, screen share demo/presentation technology and maintaining accurate account activity.
* Ability to recognize account trends, risks, and growth opportunities.
* Experience in **tax services, financial services, SaaS, professional services, affiliate/referral programs**, or another relationship\-driven business environ

jobs.description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  

  

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
  

  

This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.


**Technical Account Manager (TAM) – Strategic Accounts**
--------------------------------------------------------


**Okta: The World’s Identity Company™**


Okta is the leader in Identity management and The World’s Identity Company™. Our mission is to build a more secure world. Okta provides a neutral, powerful, and extensible platform that puts identity at the heart of your stack. Our platforms secure all types of identity, including customers, employees, partners, and AI agents.


Top brands trust Okta. We are relied upon by two thirds of the Fortune 100 and over 40% of the Forbes Global 2000 for their Identity\-powered journeys.


### **The Strategic Accounts Opportunity**


* **Okta Platform Focus:** Primary focus on Workforce Identity Solutions (Okta WIC), with foundational Customer Identity (Auth0\) exposure.
* **Segment Scope:** Strategic Accounts (Global enterprise clients with high\-complexity, multi\-org hybrid environments).
* **Travel:** Some travel is required, including in\-person onboarding and travel to our San Francisco, CA HQ OR Chicago office during the first week of employment.

This role is integral to the Strategic Segment team. As a P3 Technical Account Manager, you will serve as the primary technical advisor and advocate for a portfolio of Okta's largest, most complex global enterprises across industries such as Public Sector, Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Retail, and Technology.


### **Key Identity Solutions \& Technologies You Will Support**


You will guide enterprise customers through complex deployment architectures across core workforce solutions and developer\-focused identity integrations:


* **Workforce Identity Cloud (Primary Focus):**


	+ **Identity \& Access Management (IAM):** Single Sign\-On (SSO), Adaptive MFA, Device Access, API Access Management, Secure Partner Access, Access Gateway, and Universal Directory.
	+ **Identity Governance \& Administration (IGA):** Lifecycle Management, Workflows, and Identity Governance (automated SCIM provisioning and zero standing privileges).
	+ **Privileged Access Management (PAM):** Privileged Access controls.
	+ **Identity Threat Detection \& Response (ITDR):** Identity Security Posture Management, Identity Threat Protection, and Syslog integration.
* **Customer Identity \& Developer Tools:**


	+ Modern authentication protocols (**OAuth 2\.0, OIDC**).
	+ Direct API interactions using **Okta REST APIs**.
	+ **Okta Sign\-In Widget** and **Auth JS** SDKs for custom application authentication and login UI customization.

### **What You'll Be Doing**


#### **Strategic Partnership \& Account Leadership**


* Act as the primary technical authority and trusted advisor for identity leads, enterprise architects, and technical executives within your assigned strategic accounts.
* Independently design and drive multi\-year technical adoption roadmaps aligned with customer security posture and business goals.
* Partner closely with Customer Success Managers (CSMs) and Account Executives to secure Okta’s footprint against competitive displacement and identify expansion opportunities.

#### **Technical Execution, API Prototyping \& Advocacy**


* **Hands\-On Demos \& PoCs:** Configure test environments (e.g., Salesforce developer tenants) and build Proofs of Concept (PoCs) to demonstrate live SAML/OIDC integrations, custom login widgets, and Adaptive MFA policies.
* **API Validation \& Scripting:** Use **Postman** to test and validate Okta REST APIs (executing CRUD operations for user/group lifecycle management and policy automation).
* **Complex Problem Resolution:** Dissect multi\-faceted enterprise issues, proactively identify technical risks, and independently drive escalations through Engineering and Support.
* Serve as the voice of the strategic customer internally, influencing Okta product management and roadmap decisions.

#### **Thought Leadership \& Mentorship**


* Deliver custom technical workshops, architectural reviews, and best\-practice sessions for customer engineering teams.
* Develop repeatable technical assets, Postman collections, and deployment strategy guides for the global TAM organization.
* Mentor P1/P2 peers, driving team enablement and technical capability expansion.

### **What You'll Bring to the Role**


* **Experience:** 5\+ years of related technical experience in customer\-facing engineering roles (or 4\+ years with a Master’s degree), including 3\+ years as a Technical Account Manager, Solutions Architect, Technical Consultant, or Senior Support Engineer.
* **Domain Knowledge:** 3\+ years in identity and access management (SSO, MFA, directory services, lifecycle management, or zero trust architectures).
* **Education \& Certifications:** BA/BS/MS in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related technical discipline (or equivalent experience). Okta Certified Administrator/Consultant, CISSP, or equivalent certifications preferred.

#### **Technical Mastery**


* **Federation \& Protocols:** Practical mastery of **OAuth 2\.0**, **OpenID Connect (OIDC)**, **SAML 2\.0**, and WS\-Federation protocols.
* **API Prototyping Tools:** Hands\-on proficiency using **Postman** to execute REST API requests, manage environments/collections, and troubleshoot API integrations.
* **Development \& Web Basics:** Ability to read and modify simple web applications (e.g., HTML/JS, Node.js, Python) to demonstrate authentication flows, public vs. protected

===========================================


We’re building **Housr** to make life easier for students living off campus, from finding somewhere to live to accessing the services, offers and experiences around them.


We’ve reached $10m ARR and raised a $10m Series A to support our growth. As we expand across the UK and North America, we’re looking for a US Account Manager to manage and grow relationships with our local business and property management partners in North America.

You’ll act as the main point of contact for property and perk partners across North America—spanning national brands and local business operators—ensuring smooth onboarding, driving renewal rates, and ensuring partners deliver genuine value and enticing offers to students on the Housr platform.

**Why this role is interesting**

Our US business is growing quickly, presenting a unique opportunity to shape our partner success playbook across both student housing and perk partnerships as new campus markets come to life.


You’ll work closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to deliver seamless onboarding, drive student engagement with partner perks and offers, represent partner feedback internally, and expand revenue across accounts.

* Gathering feedback from local business owners and national brand partners to influence product strategy and positioning for the US market.
* Collaborating with GTM and marketing teams on joint promotional campaigns, local activations, and ensuring perk offers go live smoothly.
* Managing contract renewals, terms negotiation across structured and local agreements, and maintaining clear records in HubSpot.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

* Proven track record in B2B account management, client success, or partner operations managing brand or property accounts.
* Experience working within brand partnerships, local merchant services, proptech, student housing, or SaaS industries.
* Demonstrated ability to retain and expand key accounts while building strong relationships with both local business owners and mid\-market teams.
* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills with a solution\-oriented mindset.
* Proficiency with CRM tools (such as HubSpot) and analyzing partner usage metrics.
* Self\-starter attitude with the ability to operate effectively in a fast\-growing, multi\-time\-zone environment.

**A real nice to have**
-----------------------

* Direct experience managing perk, brand, or local merchant partnerships in major US college markets.
* Familiarity with launching partner offers in new geographic territories or working with local student\-focused businesses.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* 20 days PTO plus federal holidays
* 100 percent employer\-paid medical, dental, and vision, with options for dependents
* 401(k) match, life, and disability cover
* Front\-row seat to hyper\-growth \- Join a company that has gone from $0 to $10M ARR in 18 months and is just getting started in North America.
* Flexibility \& trust \- We care about outcomes, not clock\-watching. You’ll have the autonomy to do your best work.
* Work with a world\-class, global team \- Collaborate with sharp, driven teammates across the US, UK, and beyond.

**Interview process**
---------------------


We aim to keep the process straightforward and relevant to the role.

* An introductory conversation with our Talent Partner (Matt)
* Video call with our COO (Nick)

Customer Sales Representative

Good With People? Put That Skill to Work.

Some people are naturally good at talking to others.

They know how to start a conversation, ask the right questions, listen and make complicated choices easier to understand.

If that sounds like you, our client is expanding its customer\-facing sales team in the Chicago Heights, IL market and is hiring a **Customer Sales Representative**.

You'll work face\-to\-face with customers inside established retail partner locations, helping them understand available **services** through our client's campaign.

This is a full\-time position combining **customer service, retail sales, relationship building and account development**.

Previous telecommunications or wireless experience is not required.

**Paid training is provided.**

What You'll Actually Be Doing

This is an active, people\-facing position.

You won't spend your entire day behind a register or sitting at a desk.

Instead, you'll interact directly with customers inside partnered retail locations.

Your responsibilities include:

* Greeting and engaging customers face\-to\-face

The goal is to understand first and recommend second.

That's **consultative sales**, and it's a skill that translates far beyond telecommunications.

Products can be taught.

We're hiring for the qualities that are harder to teach:

new_jobs.title: Experiential Marketing Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Hadrian \- Manufacturing the Future**
=======================================


Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full\-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission\-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

  

Following our $1\.37B Series D at a $7\.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory\-as\-a\-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

  

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

  

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

**The Role**
------------


Hadrian is hiring an Experiential Marketing Manager to own every moment where someone meets Hadrian in person. This is the single owner of our events portfolio, from a twelve\-person dinner in a private room to a flagship launch built around a working factory floor.


This role exists because physical experience is our highest\-conviction channel. The people we most want to reach, the engineers building autonomous systems and the machinists and technicians who run them, do not decide where to spend the next five years of their career because of an ad. They decide after they walk a floor, put their hands on a part, and talk to the people doing the work. Your job is to engineer that encounter and then run it at scale across multiple cities.


You will inherit a portfolio that is already in motion and under\-resourced, and you will own it end to end: strategy, calendar, budget, vendors, production, staffing, and the follow\-through that turns a good night into a hire or a customer conversation. This is a builder role with real budget and real autonomy, not a coordinator role executing someone else’s brief.

**Why Now**
-----------


We are scaling our manufacturing footprint across multiple sites and hiring aggressively into the Bay Area and beyond, and our events calendar is about to go from occasional to continuous. Several things are already live: recruiting\-driven dinners and socials, a multi\-month brand and talent campaign anchored in the Bay Area, and a set of factory and site moments tied to new capability launches. The next twelve months include a flagship culminating event whose format is still being decided. You will have a direct hand in that decision rather than inheriting it.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

**Own the portfolio**

* Own the full events and experiential calendar end to end, across owned events, recruiting events, executive hosting, site and factory moments, and our presence at third\-party industry conferences.
* Build the portfolio strategy: decide what we show up to, what we build ourselves, what we sponsor, and what we decline, and be able to defend each call on audience and cost.
* Own the events budget, including vendor selection, negotiation, production spend, and reconciliation. Bring a point of view on where a dollar buys more experience.

**Build the flagship moments**

* Lead production on flagship brand and launch events, including the format decision, venue and site selection, run of show, talent and speaker logistics, and executive prep.
* Design factory and site experiences that let people see the machines and the work. Partner closely with site leadership and operations so that hosting visitors never compromises production, safety, or export\-control obligations.
* Sequence events against the broader campaign calendar, including out of home, content, and media moments, so that a launch reads as one connected push rather than several unrelated dates.

**Run the recruiting engine in person**

* Build a repeatable cadence of recruiting\-driven experiences: curated dinners and salons, technical talks and demo nights, happy hours near our sites, and targeted socials for specific engineering and skilled\-trade audiences.
* Partner with talent brand and recruiting on invite strategy, guest curation, and the handoff that turns an attendee into a pipeline candidate. Attendance is not the metric. Conversations and hires are.
* Develop formats that travel, so a dinner series or demo night can run in a new city without rebuilding it from scratch each time.
