new_jobs.title: Social Media Manager and Graphic Designer
new_jobs.description:
**About Us**

Seven Arrows is a small\-by\-design, K–6 independent elementary school in Santa Monica, California. Our mission is to inspire students to be passionate learners and compassionate leaders who value life long learning and embody integrity. We are an academically rigorous school that believes the visual and performing arts, sportsmanship, and global citizenship are just as important as core homeroom subjects.

That spirit comes to life throughout the year in our cross\-curricular festivals and every Friday morning at Kuyam, our all\-community gathering featuring student performances, our parent band, interviews with our graduating sixth graders, and special guest speakers and performers. Everything we share with the world should reflect that full picture.

We're looking for a creative, versatile storyteller who can capture the many sides of life at Seven Arrows and help us tell our story with clarity, consistency, and heart.

**The Role**

The Social Media Manager \& Graphic Designer brings the school's visual and social presence to life. This person will translate our mission, vision, and the aesthetic into compelling content across social platforms, print, and digital materials. You'll work closely with the Head of School and senior leadership team to make sure every post and every design moves our message forward.

This role is ideal for someone who can quickly absorb an organization's identity, from its values and voice to its visual style, and then produce polished work at a steady, fast pace without losing quality.

**What You'll Do**

**Social Media**

* Plan, create, and publish content across platforms, maintaining a consistent content calendar aligned with the school year and key events.
* Capture the day\-to\-day life of the school through photography, short\-form video, and stories that reflect our mission and community.
* Capture and share signature school moments, including our weekly Kuyam gatherings and cross\-curricular festivals, through photography, video, and timely posts.
* Write captions and copy in the school's voice, ensuring every post supports our messaging priorities.
* Monitor engagement and analytics, share regular insights, and adjust strategy based on what resonates with families, prospective families, and alumni.
* Respond to comments and messages in a timely, professional manner and flag sensitive issues to leadership.

**Graphic Design**

* Design print and digital materials including, but not limited to: event invitations, newsletters, signage, presentations, social graphics, and programs for festivals.
* Create internal materials for the senior leadership team, such as organizational charts, presentations, facilities planning visuals, and other documents used for school operations and planning.
* Uphold the school's brand standards, ensuring all materials match the established aesthetic.
* Maintain an organized library of templates, brand assets, and photography.
* Manage multiple projects and competing deadlines, often with quick turnarounds during peak seasons.

**What We're Looking For**

**Brand and Mission Alignment**

* A strong instinct for understanding an organization's ethos, voice, and visual identity, and the ability to reflect it quickly and accurately in your work.
* Comfort taking direction and feedback from leadership, and turning it into refined work without losing momentum.
* Genuine interest in education, the magic of childhood, and in telling the story of a school community.

**Experience and Skills**

* 3–5 years of experience in social media management, graphic design, or a combined creative role; school, nonprofit, or mission\-driven experience is a plus.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and Canva; video editing experience (Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar) strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of social scheduling and analytics tools.
* Solid photography and short\-form video skills.
* Excellent writing and editing skills with a sharp eye for detail.
* A portfolio that shows both social content and design work across print and digital.

**Work Style**

* Thrives in a fast\-paced environment and consistently delivers high\-quality work on tight timelines.
* Excellent collaborator and thrives when working in a team
* Highly organized, self\-directed, and able to juggle many projects at once.
* Adaptable and responsive to feedback.
* Available for occasional evening or weekend school events.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your resume, a brief cover letter, and a link to your portfolio. In your cover letter, tell us about a time you had to quickly learn and capture an organization's brand or voice. Finalists may be asked to complete a short design and social media exercise.

Pay: $72,000\.00 \- $78,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.description:
The Department of Medicine, Division of Cardiology has developed a clinical research infrastructure within the Division. The goals are to increase industry\-sponsored research, create a system that will assist a physician within the division to operationalize an investigator\-initiated study, and to develop a general cardiology cohort study. The purpose of this position is to carry out the needed tasks as a part of ongoing and future clinical and translational research projects in the Division of Cardiology.

  

Under the supervision of the Clinical Research Supervisor, the Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) will perform duties related to the support and coordination of clinical studies, and may receive training and development to prepare and advance to the next level within the series.

  

CRC duties may include, but will not be limited to, support the management of and coordinate the tasks of single or multiple clinical research studies, depending on their size and complexity; act as intermediary between services and departments while overseeing data and specimen management; manage and report on study results; create, update, and manage databases and comprehensive datasets and reports; help to coordinate staff work schedules to ensure proper coverage; assist with training of Assistant CRCs, and assist Clinical Research Supervisor and/or PI with oversight of other research staff; manage PI’s protocols in the Committee on Human Research online system, as well as renewals and modifications of protocol applications and the implementation of new studies; participate in the review and writing of protocols to ensure institutional review board approval and University compliance; help assure compliance with all relevant regulatory agencies; oversee study data integrity; implement and maintain periodic quality control procedures; interface with departments to obtain UCSF approval prior to study initiation; maintain all regulatory documents; report study progress to investigators; participate in any internal and external audits or reviews of study protocols; and perform other duties as assigned.

  

The Department of Medicine, Division of Cardiology has established a comprehensive, multi\-layered clinical research infrastructure to support and expand the Division’s research mission. This infrastructure supports industry\-sponsored research, facilitates investigator\-initiated studies, and advances a general cardiology cohort study, while offering clear opportunities for professional growth in clinical research operations and leadership.

  

The Cardiology Clinical Research Unit (CCRU) supports 100\-120 active clinical trials. The CCRU research portfolio covers phase I\- IV and post approval trial types and covers a diversity of trials ranging from pharmaceutical, device, preventative, and social behavioral research. Within the Division are sub\-specialty sections for: Adult Congenital Heart Disease; Advanced Heart Failure, Transplant, and Pulmonary Hypertension; Cardiac Electrophysiology; Critical Care Cardiology; Cardio\-Oncology and Immunology; Echocardiography and Cardiac Imaging; General Cardiology, Interventional Cardiology; and Prevention. The Division runs several clinical practices in multiple sites, conducts basic and clinical research, and educates medical students, residents, clinical fellows through ACGME as well as non\-ACGME training programs. In addition, the Division has significant and complex financial and administrative relationships with the Department of Medicine (DOM) and the UCSF Medical Center, as well as large patient care programs in the sections noted above, large clinical, Federal, and privately supported research programs and six faculty laboratories. The Division has 90 full\-time faculty, several non\-faculty academics, 36 clinical fellows, several post\-doctoral research fellows, and approximately 60 research support and administrative staff. The Division currently expends over $22 million per year in pursuit of its clinical, research, training, and service missions. While the Division is primarily split between the Parnassus and Mission Bay campuses, clinical fellows have rotations at the Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital and the San Francisco Veterans Affairs Medical Center.

* Demonstrated positive interpersonal skills and problem solving abilities

**Position Overview:**


Jewish National Fund\-USA is seeking a Temporary Culinary \& Events Coordinator to prepare and cook food for meetings and events, coordinate JNF House rentals, and support catering and event operations.

  

  

This is a hands\-on role combining food preparation, hospitality, and event coordination. The position requires experience working with kosher food preparation and service requirements, as well as flexibility to support events that may take place during evenings and weekends.

* Support facilities and office operational needs as needed.
* Work evenings, weekends, and occasional travel as required for events and organizational programs.

* Knowledge of food safety standards and applicable health regulations.

* Food Handler's Certification or equivalent food safety certification.

* Ability to stand for extended periods while preparing and serving food.
* Ability to lift up to 30 pounds and assist with event setup and breakdown.
* Ability to safely operate standard kitchen and food service equipment.

* Part\-time, hourly position with a minimum of 20 hours per week, plus additional hours as needed for scheduled events.

new_jobs.title: Marketing Assistant
new_jobs.description:
**Benefits:**
* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Flexible schedule
**Marketing Assistant**

  

Founded in 2008, Tutu School is a quaint and whimsical collection of boutique ballet schools designed to foster creativity and joy while encouraging tiny dancers to fully exercise their imagination as well as bodies. With over 100 locations across the U.S. and Canada, Tutu School provides an imaginative curriculum that celebrates the magic of childhood and builds confidence through movement.  

We are Tutu Collective Inc., a proud multi\-unit franchisee of Tutu School. We currently operate 11 Tutu School locations across California, New York and Connecticut. We are hiring for a Marketing Assistant. This position will report directly to the Director of Business Operations.  

**Job Summary**

  

We are looking for a Marketing Assistant who thinks like a marketer and sells like a relationship builder. This role will support local marketing efforts across our regions with a strong focus on events, partnerships, community outreach, and lead generation.  

The goal of this position is not simply to create awareness, but to turn that awareness into action: new families discovering our brand, attending a trial class, and ultimately becoming members of our community.

  

You will be responsible for the full cycle of event and partnership planning, from identifying opportunities and pitching partners to preparing for events, coordinating staffing and logistics, communicating with partners, and following up afterward. You will often be the first interaction a business, organization, influencer, or community partner has with our brand, so professionalism, confidence, and strong communication are essential.

  

This is a highly collaborative role that works closely with our Director of Business Operations, Regional Directors, Social Media Coordinator, Marketing Coordinators, and teaching teams across multiple markets.
  

**Responsibilities**
**Event \& Partnership Marketing**
* Identify and pursue local events, partnership, sponsorship, and community marketing opportunities across our regions.
* Own the full event lifecycle, including research, outreach, pitching, preparation, staffing, execution, communication, and follow\-up.
* Confidently pitch partnerships through email, phone calls, video calls, and in\-person conversations.
* Build and maintain relationships with local businesses, organizations, schools, family\-focused brands, influencers, and community groups.
* Coordinate event logistics, materials, staffing, schedules, promotional assets, and on\-site needs.
* Represent the brand professionally at community events and partnership activations.
* Follow up with event attendees and leads with the goal of driving trial classes, studio visits, and memberships.
* Track partnership and event results and identify opportunities to improve future activations.

**Local Marketing \& Lead Generation**
* Support organic marketing initiatives designed to increase local brand awareness and drive new customer acquisition.
* Help develop creative ways to bring new families into our studios and communities.
* Support promotional campaigns, local outreach, community initiatives, and grassroots marketing efforts.
* Assist with influencer partnerships, collaborations, and local creator activations.
* Develop relationships that create ongoing referral and lead\-generation opportunities.

**Content \& Social Support**
* Work closely with the Social Media Coordinator to support content creation for events, partnerships, and local marketing initiatives.
* Assist with creating simple graphics, promotional materials, Reels, and other marketing content.
* Help capture content at events and partnership activations when needed.
* Maintain brand consistency across communications and marketing materials.
* Canva and Asana experience is a plus.

**Paid Marketing Support**
* While this role is primarily focused on organic and local marketing, you should be comfortable working alongside paid marketing efforts.
* Support paid social, boosted content, and other digital campaigns as needed.
* Understand how organic partnerships and events can complement paid marketing efforts.

**What We're Looking For**
* Strong sales and relationship\-building skills with the confidence to initiate conversations and pitch opportunities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Professional, polished, and comfortable being the first point of contact with a potential partner.
* Experience working with influencers, partnerships, events, community marketing, or business development.
* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.
* Able to manage multiple events, partnerships, and deadlines across different regions.
* Self\-motivated and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
* Comfortable communicating with a wide range of people through email, phone, video calls, and in person.
* Creative and resourceful with the ability to think of new ways to connect with local families and businesses.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, multi\-location environment.
* Strong follow\-through and a proactive approach to communication.
* Experience with Canva and Asana is a plus.
* Comfortable working with social media and creating basic marketing content.
* Experience with paid social or digital advertising is a plus but not required.

**What Success Looks Like**
Success in this role means creating meaningful local connections that turn into measurable business results. You will help us expand our presence in each market, build strong community partnerships, generate new leads, and ultimately drive more families into our studios through trial classes and memberships.  

We are looking for someone who doesn't wait for opportunities to come to them. You see a local business, event, influencer, or organization and think, \\"How could we partner?\\" Then you confidently reach out, build the relationship, and make it happen.

new_jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:**


The Office Operations Coordinatoris responsible for overseeing the physical maintenance and operation of their Territory locations including combined sales and delivery, and warehouse spaces, and Branch locations. They are responsible for the local management of all Power Fleet programs and Power Fleet.


**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Oversee ongoing physical maintenance of all territory locations including repairs and housekeeping.
* Install, maintain, or move different pieces of equipment around the office.
* Actively communicate with relevant parties at HQ and territory leadership.
* Identify, manage and maintain agreements with local service providers.
* Handle daily communications between Power and Property Management
* Manage territory physical security systems and badge printing
* Seek to establish and maintain budgets for the ongoing operations for their territory.
* Assist in managing logistics, including storage, of territory property, supplies and materials inventory.
* Provide assistance with local events
* Work closely with the Business Affairs Department to assist them with initiatives, interviews, and front desk administration.
* Monitor the Facilities Ticket Queue
* Assist Fleet Team with Drivers Training and monitoring and enforcement of driver safety programs
* Fleet Administration and Communication for insurance card updates, Fleet management vendor communications, Gas Card/EZ Pass/Traffic Violations, and driver documentation and management
* Other projects as assigned by Management.


**CORE COMPETENCIES:**


Must be a go\-getter, be extremely organized, and able to manage multiple projects or requests simultaneously. Must be able to work well in a team environment, excel at research and be problem\-solution focused. Must have strong written, verbal, and quantitative skills.


**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**


High School Diploma or technical school and relevant prior work experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience, preferred.


**REQUIRED LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS:** N/A


**SALARY AND BENEFITS:**


* Salary: $65,000
* Full medical, dental, life, and disability insurance plans that can be tailored to you and your family’s specific needs
* Subsidized child care and fertility benefits
* Paid parental leave
* Free health screenings \& rewards for participation in wellness programs
* A comprehensive 401(k) retirement savings program, matched by Power
* Ample paid vacation and holidays
* An employee\-relief fund
* Year\-round events and activities, including an all expenses\-paid music festival in Cancun, Mexico for you and a significant other
* Year\-round volunteer opportunities
* Personal development \- We provide books, courses and opportunity to attend leadership conferences
* Artfully designed office spaces \& relocation opportunities


**WORK ENVIRONMENT:**


The Facilities Territory Coordinator works mostly in an office environment.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**  

The Event Coordinator supports the sales department in executing the important behind\-the\-scenes administrative functions that keep the Store functioning efficiently. Without this critical role, our efforts to provide “unreasonable hospitality” would be impossible. The Event Coordinator is responsible for supporting the sales department by way of completing administrative duties \& confirmation calls to finalize event details. Additionally, the Event Coordinator participates in the exciting sales process and is responsible for a portion of booking our valuable social market.

  

  

**YOU WILL BE AN OUTSTANDING EVENT COORDINATOR IF:**  

* You are friendly and demonstrate a “You Got It” attitude
* You demonstrate good decision\-making skills and can communicate effectively with guests, Sales Team and Management Team
* You can communicate clearly and regularly with Operations, the Sales Team and guests
* You can clearly verbalize guests needs to Operations and other Team Members
* You have strong organization skills
* You have strong verbal skills
* You are able to analyze basic data to help Operations and the Sales Team with decision making
* You can read and communicate in English
  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBLITES:**  

* Go above \& beyond to ensure the needs of each Special Events Guest are met, communicating all requests from host to ensure all contracts are updated accordingly.

new_jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
==============


Serval is an AI\-native automation platform transforming how enterprises operate. We build intelligent agents that understand real\-world workflows and execute them end\-to\-end — replacing manual processes and rigid legacy systems with adaptive, learning software. Founded in early 2024, Serval is already trusted by companies like Fox, Notion, Perplexity, Vercel, and Brex to automate high\-volume, high\-friction operational work across their organizations.  

  

At the core of Serval is an agentic AI platform that turns natural language into production\-grade workflows. Our agents don’t just respond to requests — they reason, take action across systems, and continuously improve with usage. What began with operational use cases has quickly evolved into a horizontal AI automation layer used across IT, HR, Finance, Security, Legal, and Engineering.  

  

Our mission is to eliminate repetitive, manual work across the enterprise and give teams leverage through intelligent automation. Long term, we’re building the universal AI operations layer — a system of agents that sits across business functions and runs the workflows that keep modern companies moving.  

  

We’re backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Meritech, First Round, General Catalyst, Elad Gil, and others.


**Role Overview**
=================


The opportunities that matter most are often the hardest to get in front of. As our Field Marketing Manager, you'll work side by side with Sales to bring field programs to life across segments and help execute account\-based marketing (ABM) plays for our most important accounts. This is a hands\-on role for someone early in their career who's eager to learn fast, get creative, and see their work directly open doors and move deals forward.


You'll get real ownership from day one, plus coaching and room to grow. As our West Coast presence expands, so will your scope, budget, and responsibility.

**Client Account Manager – Fixed Income / MBS**

**Location:** New York City – Midtown West  
**Work Schedule:** In\-office 4 days per week  
**Compensation:** Competitive base salary \+ commission  
**Travel:** Required

**About BondXN**

BondXN is transforming how the institutional securitized product markets trade.

Our electronic trading platform brings together buy\-side firms, mortgage originators, and broker dealers to make the trading of Mortgage\-Backed Securities (MBS) and other securitized products more efficient, transparent, and actionable. BondXN enables institutional investors to electronically conduct BWICs, access dealer liquidity, analyze market activity/data, and make better\-informed trading decisions.

We are a growing financial technology company focused on bringing greater efficiency and transparency to one of the world's largest fixed\-income markets.

**The Opportunity**

BondXN is looking for a **Client Account Manager** with at least **2 years of fixed\-income sales experience** to help grow activity and engagement across our existing client base.

This is primarily a **relationship management and account growth role**. Your most important responsibility will be to understand how our clients trade, identify opportunities to increase their use of BondXN, and work closely with them to make BondXN a more integral part of their daily workflow.

You will spend significant time with existing clients—understanding their trading activity, introducing them to additional BondXN features and capabilities, helping them get more value from the platform, and **driving increased trading volume and engagement.**

You will also have the opportunity to support senior salespeople in identifying and developing new prospects.

**What You'll Do**

**Grow Existing Client Relationships**

* Develop strong relationships with traders, portfolio managers, salespeople, and other users at our existing BondXN clients.
* Become deeply familiar with each client's trading workflow and how they use BondXN.
* Identify opportunities to increase the **frequency, breadth, and volume** of client activity.
* Introduce clients to additional BondXN functionality and new product capabilities.
* Encourage broader adoption across desks, traders, products, and trading strategies.
* Monitor client activity and proactively identify accounts where engagement can be increased.
* Work with clients to solve issues that may be preventing greater adoption.
* Become a trusted resource and day\-to\-day point of contact for your accounts.

**Travel and Client Engagement**

* Regularly visit clients throughout the **New York / New Jersey / Connecticut tri\-state area**. Occasional visits to California and other US states as well.
* Attend client meetings, trading\-desk visits, industry conferences, and other market events.

**What We're Looking For**

**Required**

* **Minimum of 2 years of professional sales experience in fixed income markets.**
* Good understanding of **MBS, mortgage trading, fixed income, or related capital markets**.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Ability to develop genuine, long\-term relationships with clients.
* Strong curiosity about how clients conduct their business and make trading decisions.
* Comfortable speaking with traders and other institutional market professionals.
* Ability to learn a sophisticated financial technology platform quickly.
* Strong organizational and follow\-up skills.
* Willingness to travel regularly for client meetings.
* Ability to work **in person in our NYC office at least 4 days per week**.

**Particularly Valuable Experience**

Experience in any of the following would be highly relevant:

* MBS / CMOs / ARMs / ABS / CMBS / RMBS
* Mortgage trading
* Fixed\-income sales
* Securitized products
* Electronic trading platforms

**The Person We're Looking For**

The ideal candidate is:

**Client\-focused.** You genuinely enjoy spending time with clients and understanding their businesses.

**Commercially minded.** You naturally look for ways to turn relationships into increased platform usage and revenue.

**Curious.** You want to understand not just what a client does, but *why* they do it.

**Persistent.** You follow up. You don't let opportunities disappear because someone didn't respond to the first email.

**Credible.** You can sit across from an experienced MBS trader and have an intelligent conversation about their business.

**Entrepreneurial.** We're a growing fintech company, and this role requires someone who is comfortable taking ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* Competitive base salary \+ commission
* 401(k)
* Medical and dental insurance
* Paid time off
* Opportunity for significant compensation growth based on performance
* Opportunity to grow into a larger sales/account\-management role as BondXN expands
* **U.S. citizen or green card holder**
* **No visa sponsorship is available, now or in the future, including OPT/CPT**

**Apply**

Please submit your resume and a brief description of your fixed\-income experience and why you are interested in BondXN.

**Employment seekers only. Recruiters, please do not contact this job poster.**

**Do not contact us with unsolicited services or offers.**

Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $180,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)

* Health insurance

The manufacturing facilities are geographically dispersed, with two facilities in Canada and one each in Colorado, Texas, Georgia, Massachusetts, Minnesota, and North Carolina.

**About the job:** Under the direction of the Plant Manager and President, this position is for the overall coordination of issuing and returning materials and operation of the Warehouse including Receiving of materials, storage, and inventory of materials. This role is the primary liaison between warehouse and procurement. This role also works closely with production, warehouse, and IT.

**Responsibilities and Contributions:**

* Primary focus is data entry for inputs into ERP System, including:
	+ Input packaging schedule into Process Pro
	+ Work order creation
	+ Work order closing
	+ Work order voiding at end of week and month end for any not used.
	+ Investigate work orders that don’t match working with the production and warehouse teams.
	+ For Month End, all work orders must be closed and voided if not used on Saturday
* Assists in training program implementation of those using the ERP system
* Assists in investigating inventory discrepancies and works with WH leadership to support.
* Reviews current inventory and coordinates WH to pull inventory from 3rd Party Warehouses (3PL’s)
* Administrative and task assistance as set forth by the plant manager.

### **JOB SPECIFIC SKILLS:**

* **Intimate knowledge of ACC \& Kenny's production and process \-** *Inside Dessert Holdings:* Interact with immediate team \& production employees, supervisors \& staff.
* **Physical Requirements \-** Move objects of up to 40 lbs.; Position self to designated working area; Operate standard office equipment; Communicate effectively with fellow employees \& clients; Assess daily tasks \& achieve them in a timely manner.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Strong understanding of inventory management, warehouse management and material scanning and handling.
* Previous experience in using (ERP)
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to interact effectively with multiple departments and customers.
* Proactive problem\-solving skills
* Knowledge of quality auditing and inspection methods.
* Intermediate Microsoft office skills (excel, word, power point).

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:**

* Associates or bachelor’s degree in business, operations management, or technical field
* Knowledge of ERP transaction auditing and interpretation methods.
* Strong organizational skills, able to prioritize responsibilities and multi\-task.
* Detail orientated and excellent analytical and project management skills.
* Bilingual with English and Spanish
* Hands\-on and team oriented
* Focused on being continuous improvement oriented.

***Swisher stands at the forefront of innovation in the consumer products industry, blending a legacy of excellence with a forward\-thinking approach. Established in 1861, the family\-owned company has evolved into a trailblazer, renowned for its iconic Swisher Sweets cigars, cutting\-edge American\-made Rogue and Ammo modern oral nicotine products, and the premium Drew Estate cigar collection, which features ACID, Liga Privada, and Undercrown. Poised for the future, Swisher is redefining traditional categories with Volt\+Co \-home to groundbreaking products such as Mojo Energy Pouches. Swisher is also home to more than two dozen American\-made, non\-combustible tobacco brands under the Helme Tobacco Co. umbrella. Based in Jacksonville, Florida, with operations spanning the U.S., the Dominican Republic, and Nicaragua, Swisher continues to lead through innovation, setting new benchmarks in quality and creativity. Learn more at swisher.com.***

  


**Primary Purpose:**



The National Account Manager manages Swisher’s key retail and wholesale accounts within Grocery and Dollar Channel and their respective distributors. This role drives volume, revenue, and share growth through strategic selling, relationship development, and flawless execution of customer business plans.


**Key** **Responsibilities**

* Manage assigned national accounts to achieve volume, revenue, and profit targets.
* Develop and execute customer business plans aligned with channel strategies and account\-specific objectives.
* Lead Joint Business Planning (JBP) and collaborate with buyers and category managers to strengthen long\-term partnerships.
* Execute insight\-driven selling that integrates category, shopper, and financial data to inform recommendations and secure new opportunities.
* Manage pricing, promotions, and trade investment to ensure ROI and budget compliance.
* Coordinate sell\-in and activation of new products, innovation, and promotional programs across the account base.
* Partner with Category Management, Shopper Insights, and Marketing to deliver tailored customer solutions that enhance brand and category performance.
* Monitor sales performance, promotional execution, and merchandising compliance through standardized scorecards and performance tracking.
* Participate in customer meetings, industry events, and trade shows to strengthen relationships and drive business visibility.
* Provide timely reporting, analysis, and insights on account performance, opportunities, and competitive activity.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

  


**Qualifications:**


***Required***


* 7\+ years of progressive sales or account management experience in consumer packaged goods or related industries.
* Proven success in managing large, complex national or regional retail accounts with measurable sales and share growth, with an emphasis on Grocery/Dollar channels.
* Experience in developing and executing customer business plans and trade programs.
* Strong financial acumen with experience managing pricing, promotions, and trade budgets.
* Proficiency with sales analytics tools, CRM platforms, and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders.
* Must be at least 21 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license.

  


*Education**:* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field.

  


*Travel:* This position requires up to 30\-50% travel, including overnight stays, based on the geographic area and customer needs.

  


***Preferred***

* Experience in consumer goods, tobacco, or regulated industries.
* Familiarity with revenue growth management, Power BI, Nielsen, or relevant analytics platforms.
* Advanced knowledge of distributor incentive programs and performance scorecards.


**Physical Requirements:**


* Must be able to lift, carry, push, or pull materials weighing up to (or exceeding) 45 lbs
* Capability to navigate convenience stores, warehouses, and retail environments, including climbing ladders and working in tight or confined spaces

**What we offer:**


* Base salary and bonus program

* Collaboration: Work closely with cross\-functional teams, including marketing, supply chain, and operations, to ensure smooth execution of sales plans, promotions, and product distribution. Work with any external rep agencies to achieve channel and customer goals.

new_jobs.title: Partner Success Manager- Account Growth & Inside Sales
new_jobs.description:
**Partner Success Manager – Account Growth \& Inside Sales**


Community Tax is looking for a **Partner Success Manager** to manage, develop, and grow relationships with our referral partners.


This is a relationship\-driven **account management role with a consultative sales component**. Our referral partners have already chosen to work with Community Tax, so you won't spend your day cold calling strangers looking for the next prospect.


Instead, you'll help partners become successful with Community Tax—building relationships, increasing referral activity, solving problems, re\-engaging less\-active accounts, and identifying additional solutions that can provide value to their businesses.


**This isn't a traditional high\-pressure sales role—and it isn't a traditional customer service role.**


We're looking for someone in between: **a relationship builder with commercial instincts.**


**What You'll Do**


You'll manage an assigned portfolio of Community Tax referral partners and serve as their primary day\-to\-day point of contact.


You'll:


* Onboard new partners and help them successfully make their first referral.
* Build strong relationships and understand each partner's business and referral needs.
* Conduct regular check\-ins and proactive account outreach.
* Monitor referral activity, engagement, and overall account health.
* Recognize when activity slows or changes, find out why, and work to re\-engage the partner.
* Identify opportunities to increase referrals and expand productive partner relationships.
* Answer questions, solve problems, and coordinate with internal teams when assistance is needed.
* Introduce additional Community Tax products and solutions when they can provide genuine value.
* Maintain accurate account activity, notes, and follow\-up within our CRM.


**The Person We're Looking For**


The strongest Partner Success Managers understand that **relationship building and sales aren't competing responsibilities**.


You build trust, ask good questions, understand what a partner needs, recognize opportunities, recommend appropriate solutions, and aren't afraid to ask for the business when the solution makes sense.


You don't need to be a hard\-closing, commission\-driven salesperson to succeed here. But you **do** need to be comfortable with sales, persuasion, business conversations, measurable goals, and being accountable for growth.


**You may be a strong fit if you:**


* Build rapport and credibility naturally.
* Enjoy developing ongoing business relationships.
* Are proactive rather than waiting for someone to ask for help.
* Listen well and ask effective questions.
* Notice changes in account activity and want to understand why.
* Can recommend a solution without making the relationship feel transactional.
* Are comfortable discussing products, money, business needs, and opportunities.
* Can address questions or objections and confidently move a conversation toward action.
* Stay organized while managing multiple accounts and follow\-ups.
* Take ownership and follow through on commitments.


Your previous title might be **Account Manager, Inside Sales Representative, Customer Success Manager, Partner Success Manager, Relationship Manager, Business Development Representative**, or something completely different.


We're more interested in whether you've developed the right combination of relationship and commercial skills.


**Compensation \& Incentives**


**Base Salary: $50,000**


In addition to base salary, Partner Success Managers are eligible for:


* **10% – 20% annual performance bonus opportunity**, paid quarterly based on applicable partner performance measures.
* **CTAX Intelligence revenue incentive** on qualifying revenue collected within onboarded and assigned accounts.
* Additional **Phase One sales incentives** during the March–May tax\-season sales assignment.


**Consultative Solution Sales**


As part of the role, you'll be trained to introduce, demonstrate, and sell **CTAX Intelligence**, our subscription\-based SaaS transcript solution designed specifically for our target market.


This is consultative selling: understand the partner's business, identify a need, demonstrate the solution, answer questions, address objections, and confidently ask for the business when there's a good fit.


The goal isn't to turn every conversation into a sales pitch. It's to know your partners well enough to recognize when Community Tax has something that can genuinely help them—and to be comfortable having that conversation.


**A Seasonal Change of Pace**


From approximately **March through May**, Partner Success Managers also help Community Tax's consumer sales organization manage increased tax\-season demand.


You'll receive comprehensive Phase One tax resolution sales training and work with qualified prospective clients to understand their needs, explain our Phase One service, and help appropriate clients enroll.


You'll also have an opportunity to earn additional sales incentives during this seasonal assignment.


After tax season, your primary focus returns to your referral partner portfolio.


**Qualifications**


* 2\+ years of relevant experience in **account management, inside sales, partner or customer success, relationship management, business development**, or a comparable client\-facing role preferred.
* Strong relationship\-building, verbal, and written communication skills.
* Comfortable with **consultative selling and persuasive business conversations**.
* Strong organization, prioritization, and follow\-through.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts, priorities, and commitments.
* Comfortable using CRM technology, screen share demo/presentation technology and maintaining accurate account activity.
* Ability to recognize account trends, risks, and growth opportunities.
* Experience in **tax services, financial services, SaaS, professional services, affiliate/referral programs**, or another relationship\-driven business environ

Robinson’s services, technology, and processes, to retain and grow strategic accounts through integrated, multi\-service solutions and strong senior customer relationships.

* Monitor account performance and health using internal tools and customer feedback to drive proactive planning

**Business Development and Customer Growth**

* Own the account growth strategy and partner with the team to execute expansion plans across products, services, and geographies
* Engage with senior customer stakeholders to uncover long\-term opportunities and align growth strategies with their evolving needs
* Support team members in identifying, qualifying, and advancing new business opportunities within their accounts
* Guide the development of multi\-service solutions that meet customer objectives and create long\-term value
* Participate in high\-value negotiations and solution design, providing strategic oversight and escalation support

**Customer Experience and Advocacy**

* Serve as the escalation point for strategic customer issues that require cross\-functional coordination or executive engagement
* Partner with internal teams, including operations, product, pricing, capacity, and technology, to align resources and resolve barriers
* Ensure customer feedback and long\-term needs are translated into actionable improvements across departments
* Champion digital adoption and analytics\-driven decision\-making across the account team to enhance the customer experience
* Represent the customer perspective in cross\-functional initiatives that impact service delivery and process improvement
